def predict(state) -> dict:
    raw = state if isinstance(state, str) else str(state)
    text = _normalize(raw)
    if not text:
        return {"answer": "world"}

    first_part = re.split(r"\s+[—–-]\s+|:\s+", raw, maxsplit=1)[0]
    headline = _normalize(first_part)

    sports = _score(text, SPORTS)
    tech = _score(text, TECH)
    business = _score(text, BUSINESS)
    world = _score(text, WORLD)

    tech_firm = _has(text, TECH_COMPANIES)
    if _has(text, r"amazon (?:rainforest|forest|river|basin|jungle)"):
        if not _has(text, r"amazon (?:com|web services|aws|prime)"):
            tech_firm = False
    if _has(text, r"apple(?:s)? (?:orchard|crop|harvest|juice|tree|fruit)"):
        if not _has(text, r"apple (?:inc|computer|iphone|ipad)"):
            tech_firm = False

    finance_event = _has(text, FINANCIAL_EVENT)
    broad_market = _has(text, BROAD_MARKET)
    sport_anchor = _has(text, SPORT_ANCHOR)
    sport_result = _has(text, SPORT_RESULT)
    sport_setting = _has(text, SPORT_SETTING)
    video_game = _has(text, VIDEO_GAMES)

    hardware = _has(
        text,
        r"computer(?:s)?|laptop(?:s)?|server(?:s)?|"
        r"chipmaker(?:s)?|chip maker(?:s)?|chip designer(?:s)?|"
        r"chip(?:s)?|processor(?:s)?|semiconductor(?:s)?|"
        r"circuit(?:s)?|software|smartphone(?:s)?|"
        r"internet|online marketplace(?:s)?|"
        r"social platform(?:s)?|telecom(?:s|munications)?",
    )
    generic_tech_company = _has(
        text,
        r"computer compan(?:y|ies)|software compan(?:y|ies)|"
        r"technology compan(?:y|ies)|tech compan(?:y|ies)|"
        r"chip compan(?:y|ies)|semiconductor compan(?:y|ies)|"
        r"chipmaker(?:s)?|chip maker(?:s)?|"
        r"chip designer(?:s)?|internet compan(?:y|ies)",
    )
    tech_actor = tech_firm or generic_tech_company

    if tech_firm:
        tech += 10
    if generic_tech_company:
        tech += 9
    if tech_actor and finance_event:
        tech += 10 if not broad_market else 5
    elif hardware and finance_event:
        tech += 7 if not broad_market else 2

    if tech_actor and _has(
        text,
        r"launch(?:es|ed|ing)?|releas(?:e|es|ed|ing)|"
        r"unveil(?:s|ed|ing)?|develop(?:s|ed|ing)?|"
        r"updat(?:e|es|ed|ing)|lawsuit(?:s)?|"
        r"antitrust|patent(?:s)?",
    ):
        tech += 5

    if _has(text, RESEARCH) and _has(text, MEDICAL):
        tech += 10
    elif _has(
        text,
        r"new drug(?:s)?|new vaccine(?:s)?|"
        r"new treatment(?:s)?|drug approval|"
        r"vaccine approval|clinical trial(?:s)?",
    ):
        tech += 7

    if _has(
        text,
        r"space|satellite(?:s)?|rocket(?:s)?|"
        r"spacecraft|astronaut(?:s)?|moon|mars|"
        r"orbit(?:s|al|ing)?|nasa",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"launch(?:es|ed|ing)?|mission(?:s)?|"
        r"explor(?:e|es|ed|ation)|land(?:s|ed|ing)?|"
        r"orbit(?:s|ed|ing)?",
    ):
        tech += 9

    if sport_anchor and (sport_result or sport_setting):
        sports += 7
    elif sport_result and sport_setting and not video_game:
        sports += 7

    if _has(
        text,
        r"coach(?:es|ed)?|athlete(?:s)?|player(?:s)?|"
        r"teammate(?:s)?|swimmer(?:s)?|runner(?:s)?|"
        r"cyclist(?:s)?|racing driver(?:s)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"qualif(?:y|ies|ied|ying)|final(?:s)?|"
        r"race(?:s)?|match(?:es)?|game(?:s)?|"
        r"win(?:s|ning)?|won|record|lap(?:s)?|heat(?:s)?",
    ):
        sports += 5

    if _has(text, r"pole position|starting grid|final lap"):
        sports += 7
    if video_game:
        sports = max(0, sports - 7)

    if broad_market:
        business += 7
    if _has(
        text,
        r"oil|crude|gasoline|commodity|commodities",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"pric(?:e|es)|cost(?:s)?|trading|"
        r"market(?:s)?|barrel(?:s)?|opec",
    ):
        business += 6
    if _has(
        text,
        r"compan(?:y|ies)|corporat(?:ion|ions|e)|"
        r"firm(?:s)?|business(?:es)?|retail(?:er|ers)?|"
        r"airline(?:s)?|bank(?:s)?",
    ) and finance_event and not tech_actor:
        business += 5

    if _has(
        text,
        r"airline(?:s)?|airway(?:s)?|aircraft|"
        r"plane(?:s)?|flight(?:s)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"crash(?:es|ed)?|disaster|"
        r"kill(?:s|ed)?|fatalit(?:y|ies)|"
        r"emergency landing",
    ):
        world += 13

    if _has(
        text,
        r"earthquake(?:s)?|hurricane(?:s)?|"
        r"flood(?:s|ing)?|wildfire(?:s)?|tsunami(?:s)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"kill(?:s|ed)?|dead|evacuat(?:e|es|ed|ion)|"
        r"destroy(?:s|ed)?|rescue(?:s|d)?",
    ):
        world += 6

    if _has(
        text,
        r"missile(?:s)?|airstrike(?:s)?|"
        r"bomb(?:s|ed|ing)?|attack(?:s|ed|ing)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"troop(?:s)?|military|war|rebel(?:s)?|"
        r"civilian(?:s)?|kill(?:s|ed|ing)?|soldier(?:s)?",
    ):
        world += 7

    if tech_actor and _has(
        text,
        r"lawsuit(?:s)?|su(?:e|es|ed|ing)|"
        r"antitrust|patent(?:s)?|court(?:s)?|"
        r"judge(?:s)?|trial(?:s)?",
    ):
        tech += 7

    if _has(
        text,
        r"president(?:s)?|chief executive(?:s)?|ceo(?:s)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"compan(?:y|ies)|corporat(?:ion|ions)|"
        r"firm(?:s)?",
    ) and not _has(
        text,
        r"election(?:s)?|government|"
        r"parliament|white house",
    ):
        world = max(0, world - 5)

    # Give a headline's actual subject more weight than incidental background
    # in a following explanatory clause.
    if headline and headline != text:
        if _has(headline, SPORT_ANCHOR):
            sports += 4
        if _has(
            headline,
            r"chipmaker(?:s)?|chip maker(?:s)?|"
            r"chip designer(?:s)?|computer(?:s)?|"
            r"software|internet|online marketplace(?:s)?|"
            r"social platform(?:s)?|physicist(?:s)?|"
            r"scientist(?:s)?|spacecraft|nasa",
        ) or (tech_firm and _has(headline, TECH_COMPANIES)):
            tech += 4
        if _has(
            headline,
            r"stock market(?:s)?|wall street|"
            r"econom(?:y|ic)|inflation|"
            r"oil price(?:s)?|airline(?:s)?|"
            r"merger(?:s)?|retail(?:er|ers|ing)?",
        ):
            business += 4
        if _has(
            headline,
            r"election(?:s)?|war|terroris(?:m|t|ts)|"
            r"earthquake(?:s)?|hurricane(?:s)?|"
            r"murder(?:s|ed)?|bombing(?:s)?|"
            r"government|parliament",
        ):
            world += 4

    scores = {
        "business": business,
        "sci_tech": tech,
        "sports": sports,
        "world": world,
    }
    highest = max(scores.values())
    if highest <= 0:
        return {"answer": "world"}

    leaders = [label for label, points in scores.items() if points == highest]
    if len(leaders) == 1:
        return {"answer": leaders[0]}

    if "sports" in leaders and sport_anchor and (sport_result or sport_setting):
        return {"answer": "sports"}
    if "sci_tech" in leaders and tech_actor and not _has(headline, BROAD_MARKET):
        return {"answer": "sci_tech"}
    if "business" in leaders and _has(headline, BROAD_MARKET):
        return {"answer": "business"}
    if "world" in leaders and _has(
        headline,
        r"war|terroris(?:m|t|ts)|earthquake|"
        r"tsunami|hurricane|election(?:s)?|"
        r"murder(?:s|ed)?",
    ):
        return {"answer": "world"}
    if "sci_tech" in leaders and hardware:
        return {"answer": "sci_tech"}

import re
import unicodedata


def _normalize(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        value = str(value)
    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value.lower())
    value = "".join(ch for ch in value if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", value).strip()


def _has(text, pattern):
    return re.search(r"\b(?:" + pattern + r")\b", text) is not None


def _score(text, groups):
    return sum(points for points, pattern in groups if _has(text, pattern))

        text,
        r"pric(?:e|es)|cost(?:s)?|trading|"
        r"market(?:s)?|barrel(?:s)?|opec",
    ):
        business += 6
    if _has(
        text,
        r"compan(?:y|ies)|corporat(?:ion|ions|e)|"
        r"firm(?:s)?|business(?:es)?|retail(?:er|ers)?|"
        r"airline(?:s)?|bank(?:s)?",
    ) and finance_event and not tech_actor:
        business += 5

    if _has(
        text,
        r"airline(?:s)?|airway(?:s)?|aircraft|"
        r"plane(?:s)?|flight(?:s)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"crash(?:es|ed)?|disaster|"
        r"kill(?:s|ed)?|fatalit(?:y|ies)|"
        r"emergency landing",
    ):
        world += 13

    if _has(
        text,
        r"earthquake(?:s)?|hurricane(?:s)?|"
        r"flood(?:s|ing)?|wildfire(?:s)?|tsunami(?:s)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"kill(?:s|ed)?|dead|evacuat(?:e|es|ed|ion)|"
        r"destroy(?:s|ed)?|rescue(?:s|d)?",
    ):
        world += 6

    if _has(
        text,
        r"missile(?:s)?|airstrike(?:s)?|"
        r"bomb(?:s|ed|ing)?|attack(?:s|ed|ing)?",
    ) and _has(
        text,
        r"troop(?:s)?|military|war|rebel(?:s)?|"
        r"civilian(?:s)?|kill(?:s|ed|ing)?|soldier(?:s)?",
    ):
        world += 7

    if tech_actor and _has(
        text,
        r"lawsuit(?:s)?|su(?:e|es|ed|ing)|"
        r"antitrust|patent(?:s)?|court(?:s)?|"
        r"judge(?:s)?|trial(?:s)?",
    ):
        tech += 7

    if _has(
        text, r"president(?:s)?|chief executive(?:s)?|ceo(?:s)?"
    ) and _has(
        text, r"compan(?:y|ies)|corporat(?:ion|ions)|firm(?:s)?"
    ) and not _has(
        text, r"election(?:s)?|government|parliament|white house"
    ):
        world = max(0, world - 5)

    # A headline normally identifies the main event; its explanatory clause
    # can mention another subject without changing the story's category.
    if headline and headline != text:
        if _has(headline, SPORT_ANCHOR):
            sports += 4
        if _has(
            headline,
            r"chipmaker(?:s)?|chip maker(?:s)?|"
            r"chip designer(?:s)?|computer(?:s)?|"
            r"software|internet|online marketplace(?:s)?|"
            r"social platform(?:s)?|physicist(?:s)?|"
            r"scientist(?:s)?|spacecraft|nasa|"
            r"medical trial(?:s)?|clinical trial(?:s)?|"
            r"phone network(?:s)?|mobile network(?:s)?",
        ) or (tech_firm and _has(headline, TECH_COMPANIES)):
            tech += 4
        if _has(
            headline,
            r"stock market(?:s)?|wall street|"
            r"econom(?:y|ic)|inflation|"
            r"oil price(?:s)?|airline(?:s)?|"
            r"merger(?:s)?|retail(?:er|ers|ing)?",
        ):
            business += 4
        if _has(
            headline,
            r"election(?:s)?|war|terroris(?:m|t|ts)|"
            r"earthquake(?:s)?|hurricane(?:s)?|"
            r"murder(?:s|ed)?|bombing(?:s)?|"
            r"government|parliament",
        ):
            world += 4

    scores = {
        "business": business,
        "sci_tech": tech,
        "sports": sports,
        "world": world,
    }
    highest = max(scores.values())
    if highest <= 0:
        return {"answer": "world"}

    leaders = [label for label, points in scores.items() if points == highest]
    if len(leaders) == 1:
        return {"answer": leaders[0]}

    if "sports" in leaders and (
        (sport_anchor and (sport_result or sport_setting))
        or (sports_person and sports_organization and _has(text, SPORT_TRANSFER))
    ):
        return {"answer": "sports"}
    if "sci_tech" in leaders and tech_actor and not _has(headline, BROAD_MARKET):
        return {"answer": "sci_tech"}
    if "business" in leaders and _has(headline, BROAD_MARKET):
        return {"answer": "business"}
    if "world" in leaders and _has(
        headline,
        r"war|terroris(?:m|t|ts)|earthquake|"
        r"tsunami|hurricane|election(?:s)?|murder(?:s|ed)?",
    ):
        return {"answer": "world"}
    if "sci_tech" in leaders and (
        hardware or medical_research or _has(text, PHONE_NETWORK)
    ):
        return {"answer": "sci_tech"}
    if "business" in leaders and finance_event:
        return {"answer": "business"}
    if "sports" in leaders and sport_anchor:
        return {"answer": "sports"}
    if "world" in leaders:
        return {"answer": "world"}
    if "sci_tech" in leaders:
        return {"answer": "sci_tech"}
    return {"answer": "business" if "business" in leaders else "sports"}

import re
import unicodedata


def _normalize(value):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(value or ""))
    text = "".join(ch for ch in text if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    text = text.lower().replace("’", "'")
    text = re.sub(r"\bcan't\b", "can not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bwon't\b", "will not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'s\b", r"\1 is", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'ve\b", r"\1 have", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'m\b", r"\1 am", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'d\b", r"\1 would", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'ll\b", r"\1 will", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\btop[\s-]?up\b", "top up", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bmaster[\s-]?card\b", "mastercard", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bgoogle[\s-]?pay\b", "google pay", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bapple[\s-]?pay\b", "apple pay", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text)
    return " ".join(text.split())


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    scores = {}

    def h(pattern):
        return re.search(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + pattern + r")(?!\w)", text) is not None

    def near(first, second, distance=90):
        a = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + first + r")(?!\w)", text))
        b = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + second + r")(?!\w)", text))
        return any(
            max(x.start() - y.end(), y.start() - x.end(), 0) <= distance
            for x in a for y in b
        )

    def put(label, strength):
        scores[label] = max(scores.get(label, 0), strength)

    card = h(r"cards?|plastic")
    virtual = h(r"virtual|digital card|online card|e card|electronic card")
    disposable = h(r"disposable|single use|one time use|one use")
    physical = h(r"physical|plastic|tangible|real card")
    atm = h(
        r"atms?|cash ?machines?|cashpoints?|cash withdrawals?|"
        r"withdraw(?:ing|n|al|als)?|take out cash|taking out cash|"
        r"get cash out"
    )
    deposit_cash = h(
        r"cash deposit|deposit(?:ed|ing)? cash|cheques?|checks?|"
        r"cash into (?:my|the) account|pay in cash|paid in cash"
    )
    topup = h(
        r"top up|topping up|add(?:ing|ed)? (?:money|funds|cash|credit)|"
        r"load(?:ing|ed)? (?:money|funds|cash|my card|the card)|"
        r"recharg(?:e|ed|ing)|fund(?:ing)? (?:my|the) account"
    )
    transfer = h(
        r"transfers?|transferr(?:ed|ing)|bank wire|wire payment|"
        r"remittance|remit|iban|swift|send(?:ing|s|t)? money|"
        r"money sent|pay(?:ing)? (?:a |my |the )?beneficiar(?:y|ies)"
    )
    direct_debit = h(r"direct debit|standing order|recurring bank debit")
    purchase = h(
        r"purchas(?:e|ed|ing)|merchant|retailer|shop|store|checkout|"
        r"point of sale|pos terminal|paid (?:at|in|for|with)|"
        r"buy(?:ing|ought)?|card payment|card transaction"
    )
    payment = h(r"payments?|paid|paying|purchases?|transactions?|charges?")
    card_payment = (
        h(r"card payment|card transaction|debit card payment|credit card payment")
        or (card and (purchase or near(r"cards?", r"payments?|paid|charges?|transactions?")))
        or (purchase and not (topup or transfer or atm or direct_debit))
        or (payment and not (transfer or topup or atm or direct_debit or deposit_cash))
    )
    fee = h(
        r"fees?|surcharges?|commission|extra charges?|additional charges?|"
        r"charged (?:me )?(?:for|a fee)|charges? for|cost(?:s)? (?:to|of)|"
        r"payment charges?|withdrawal charges?|transfer charges?"
    )
    rate = h(
        r"exchange rates?|conversion rates?|fx rates?|forex rates?|"
        r"currency rates?|rate of exchange|wrong rate|bad rate"
    )
    exchange = h(
        r"exchang(?:e|ing|ed)|convert(?:ing|ed|s)?|conversion|"
        r"swap(?:ping)? (?:currenc(?:y|ies)|money)|fx|forex"
    )
    unrecognized = h(
        r"do not recogni[sz]e|not recogni[sz]e|unrecogni[sz]ed|"
        r"not mine|not my (?:payment|transaction|withdrawal|charge)|"
        r"never (?:made|did|authori[sz]ed|withdrew|bought|paid)|"
        r"did not (?:make|authori[sz]e|withdraw|pay|buy)|"
        r"unauthori[sz]ed|unknown (?:payment|transaction|charge|withdrawal)|"
        r"fraudulent (?:payment|transaction|charge|withdrawal)|"
        r"who (?:made|authori[sz]ed) (?:this|the)"
    )
    declined = h(
        r"declin(?:e|ed|ing)|reject(?:ed|ion|ing)?|refus(?:ed|al)|"
        r"denied|not accepted|would not accept|not allowed|"
        r"would not let me (?:pay|withdraw|transfer|send)"
    )
    failed = h(
        r"fail(?:ed|ing|ure|s)?|unsuccessful|did not go through|"
        r"has not gone through|could not go through|"
        r"not going through|would not go through|"
        r"did not work|does not work|not working|cannot (?:send|transfer|top up)"
    )
    pending = h(
        r"pending|processing|in progress|on hold|stuck|"
        r"still waiting|not (?:yet )?(?:completed|complete|finali[sz]ed)|"
        r"taking (?:so )?long to (?:process|complete|clear)"
    )
    reversed_ = h(
        r"revert(?:ed|ing)?|revers(?:ed|al|ing)|"
        r"cancelled (?:automatically|by itself)|bounced back|"
        r"sent back|returned (?:to my|to the|back to)|"
        r"money (?:was|has been) (?:taken back|returned)"
    )
    missing = h(
        r"not (?:showing|appearing|visible|there|arrived|received|credited)|"
        r"has not (?:shown|appeared|arrived|come|been credited|updated)|"
        r"did not (?:show|appear|arrive|receive|get credited)|"
        r"still (?:not|missing)|missing|where is|where did .* go|"
        r"no sign of|not in (?:my|the) account|not reflected"
    )
    how = h(
        r"how (?:do|can|could|would|should|to)|where (?:can|do|to)|"
        r"want to|would like to|need to|trying to"
    )
    time = h(
        r"how long|when (?:will|does|do|should|can)|"
        r"how (?:fast|soon|quickly)|time(?:frame|scale)?|"
        r"how many (?:days|hours|weeks)|estimated|estimate|eta|"
        r"delivery date|arrival date"
    )
    incoming = h(
        r"into (?:my|the|our) account|to (?:my|the|our) account|"
        r"to me|someone (?:sent|transferred|paid)|"
        r"receive(?:d|ing)? (?:money|funds|a payment|a transfer)|"
        r"incoming|inbound|bank deposit|pay (?:me|into)"
    )
    recipient = h(
        r"recipient|beneficiar(?:y|ies)|person i sent|"
        r"person i (?:paid|transferred)|they (?:have not|did not) receive|"
        r"has not received (?:my|the) (?:money|transfer|payment)|"
        r"not (?:reached|arrived at) (?:the|their|his|her) account|"
        r"other account|to (?:his|her|their) account"
    )

    # Security, access, identity, and account details.
    phone = h(r"phone|mobile|handset|smartphone|device")
    loss = h(r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing")
    if phone and loss and near(r"phone|mobile|handset|smartphone|device",
                               r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"):
        put("lost_or_stolen_phone", 30)
    if card and loss and near(r"cards?|plastic",
                              r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"):
        put("lost_or_stolen_card", 29)
    if card and h(
        r"compromised|cloned|skimmed|card details (?:stolen|leaked|exposed)|"
        r"card number (?:stolen|leaked|exposed)|"
        r"someone (?:has|knows) my card (?:details|number)|"
        r"card (?:security|information) (?:breach|leak)"
    ):
        put("compromised_card", 31)
    if h(r"passcode|pass code|app pin|login pin|login code|access code") and h(
        r"forgot|forgotten|cannot remember|can not remember|do not remember|"
        r"lost|reset|recover"
    ):
        put("passcode_forgotten", 29)
    if h(r"\bpin\b|pin number") and h(
        r"blocked|locked|too many (?:attempts|tries)|"
        r"wrong pin (?:too many|several|multiple) times|unblock|unlock"
    ):
        put("pin_blocked", 29)
    if h(r"\bpin\b|pin number") and h(
        r"change|reset|update|new pin|choose|set|forgot|remember"
    ):
        put("change_pin", 23 if h(r"blocked|locked|unblock") else 28)
    if h(
        r"personal details|personal information|profile|address|"
        r"phone number|email address|legal name|surname|date of birth"
    ) and h(r"change|edit|update|correct|modify|wrong|new|move|moved"):
        put("edit_personal_details", 29)
    if h(r"account") and h(
        r"close|terminate|delete|deactivate|shut down|cancel my account|"
        r"stop using|permanently remove"
    ):
        put("terminate_account", 30)
    if h(r"age|years old|birthday|minor|underage|under 18|over 18|adult") and h(
        r"minimum|limit|requirement|eligible|old enough|open|account|card|join|sign up"
    ):
        put("age_limit", 30)

    identity = h(
        r"identit(?:y|ies)|id document|passport|driver(?:s)? licen[cs]e|"
        r"selfie|know your customer|kyc|verification|verify (?:me|myself)"
    )
    verify = h(r"verif(?:y|ication|ied)|confirm|prove|validate|identification")
    if h(r"source of funds|source of wealth|proof of funds|origin of (?:my |the )?funds|"
         r"where (?:my |the )?money (?:came|comes) from"):
        put("verify_source_of_funds", 33)
    if identity and verify and h(
        r"cannot|can not|unable|trouble|problem|keeps failing|"
        r"rejected|not accepted|does not work|unsuccessful|stuck|"
        r"documents? (?:rejected|failed)|verification failed"
    ):
        put("unable_to_verify_identity", 32)
    if identity and verify and h(
        r"why|reason|necessary|have to|need to|required|requirement|"
        r"what for|purpose"
    ):
        put("why_verify_identity", 30)
    if identity and (verify or h(r"submit|upload|documents?")):
        put("verify_my_identity", 23)
    if topup and verify and not identity:
        put("verify_top_up", 31)
    if h(r"top up verification|verify (?:a |my |the )?top up|"
         r"verify (?:the |my )?(?:card|payment) (?:for|to) (?:a |my )?top up"):
        put("verify_top_up", 32)

    # Card provisioning, delivery, and operation.
    if h(r"apple pay|google pay|apple wallet|google wallet|gpay|"
         r"add (?:my |the )?card to (?:my )?(?:iphone|wallet)|"
         r"pay with (?:my )?(?:iphone|android|phone)"):
        put("apple_pay_or_google_pay", 33)
    if h(r"visa|mastercard|master card|card network") and h(
        r"card|visa|mastercard|network|which|do you|is it"
    ):
        put("visa_or_mastercard", 29)
    if card and h(
        r"activat(?:e|ion|ed|ing)|enable (?:my |the )?card|"
        r"start using (?:my |the )?(?:new )?card"
    ):
        put("activate_my_card", 31)
    if card and h(
        r"expir(?:e|es|ed|ing|y|ation)|valid until|valid thru|"
        r"expiring soon|out of date|renew(?:al|ed)?"
    ):
        put("card_about_to_expire", 31)
    if card and h(
        r"link(?:ed|ing)?|connect(?:ed|ing)?|"
        r"attach(?:ed|ing)?|pair(?:ed|ing)?"
    ) and h(r"account|app|card"):
        put("card_linking", 29)
    if card and h(
        r"swallowed|eaten|kept my card|retained my card|"
        r"atm (?:took|kept|ate)|card (?:stuck|trapped) in (?:an? )?(?:atm|machine)"
    ):
        put("card_swallowed", 34)
    if card and h(
        r"spare|backup|replacement|replace my card|replace the card|"
        r"another card|second card|extra card|new card because"
    ) and h(r"get|order|request|need|want|send|replace|obtain|how"):
        put("getting_spare_card", 29)
    if disposable and card and h(
        r"limit|maximum|max|how many|number of|"
        r"how often|frequency|per day|per month|restriction"
    ):
        put("disposable_card_limits", 33)
    if disposable and (card or virtual) and h(
        r"get|create|generate|make|obtain|request|order|"
        r"how|where|want|need|available"
    ):
        put("get_disposable_virtual_card", 31)
    if virtual and card and h(
        r"not working|does not work|did not work|cannot use|can not use|"
        r"declined|rejected|failed|problem|issue|unable to (?:use|pay)|"
        r"not accepted"
    ):
        put("virtual_card_not_working", 32)
    if virtual and (card or h(r"create|generate")) and h(
        r"get|create|generate|obtain|order|request|"
        r"how|where|want|need|available|apply"
    ):
        put("getting_virtual_card", 25 if disposable else 30)
    if physical and card and h(
        r"order|request|apply for|place an order"
    ) and not h(r"replacement|replace|spare|backup"):
        put("order_physical_card", 30)
    if physical and card and h(
        r"get|obtain|receive|how|where|want|need|available|"
        r"can i have|send me"
    ) and not h(r"replacement|replace|spare|backup"):
        put("get_physical_card", 25 if h(r"order|request") else 29)

    delivery = card and h(
        r"deliver(?:y|ed|ing)?|arriv(?:e|ed|al|ing)|"
        r"ship(?:ped|ping|ment)?|post(?:ed|age)?|mail(?:ed|ing)?|"
        r"dispatch(?:ed)?|come in the post|on its way"
    )
    if delivery and time:
        put("card_delivery_estimate", 31)
    if delivery and h(
        r"not (?:yet )?(?:arrived|delivered|received|come)|"
        r"has not (?:arrived|come|been delivered)|"
        r"still waiting|where is|track|lost in (?:the )?post|"
        r"late|overdue|never (?:arrived|came)|missing"
    ):
        put("card_arrival", 33)
    if delivery and not time:
        put("card_arrival", 22)
    if card and h(
        r"where (?:can|will) (?:i|my card) (?:use|pay|work)|"
        r"accept(?:ed|ance)?|use (?:my |the )?card (?:in|at|abroad)|"
        r"which (?:shops|stores|merchants|places)|"
        r"can (?:i |we )?(?:pay|purchase|buy) (?:with|using) (?:my |the )?card"
    ) and not (declined or failed):
        put("card_acceptance", 28)
    if h(r"contactless|tap to pay|tap and pay|nfc|paywave|paypass|"
         r"tap (?:my |the )?card") and (

    ):
        put("contactless_not_working", 33)
    if card and h(
        r"not working|does not work|did not work|cannot use|can not use|"
        r"unable to use|card is broken|card stopped working|"
        r"problem with (?:my |the )?card|card does not function|"
        r"card is faulty"
    ):
        put("card_not_working", 23 if virtual or h(r"contactless") else 28)

    # Supported facilities, locations, and currencies.
    if h(r"atm|cash machine|cashpoint") and h(
        r"which|where|support|compatible|use|work|available|network|"
        r"find|accept|withdraw"
    ) and not (failed or declined or fee or pending or unrecognized):
        put("atm_support", 28)
    if h(
        r"countries|country|region|territor(?:y|ies)|"
        r"nationalit(?:y|ies)|resident|residency"
    ) and h(
        r"support|available|eligible|open an account|sign up|"
        r"operate|service|join|live in|based in|which|what|where"
    ) and not (card and h(r"use|accepted|work|pay")):
        put("country_support", 29)
    if h(r"currenc(?:y|ies)|fiat|dollars?|euros?|pounds?|gbp|usd|eur") and h(
        r"support|available|which|what|hold|account|"
        r"add|use|accepted|list"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or fee):
        put("fiat_currency_support", 27)
    if card and h(r"currenc(?:y|ies)|fiat|visa|mastercard") and h(
        r"support|accepted|eligible|which|what|"
        r"top up|use to add|can i use"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or fee):
        put("supported_cards_and_currencies", 28)

    # Unauthorised transactions, discrepancies, and card payments.
    if direct_debit and unrecognized:
        put("direct_debit_payment_not_recognised", 36)
    if atm and unrecognized:
        put("cash_withdrawal_not_recognised", 35)
    if card_payment and unrecognized and not direct_debit and not atm:
        put("card_payment_not_recognised", 34)
    if unrecognized and h(r"payment|purchase|transaction|charge") and not (
        atm or direct_debit or transfer or topup
    ):
        put("card_payment_not_recognised", 31)
    if h(
        r"charged twice|charged (?:me )?(?:two|2) times|"
        r"double charged|duplicate (?:charge|payment|transaction|debit)|"
        r"same (?:payment|transaction|charge) twice|"
        r"debited twice|paid twice|two identical (?:charges|payments)"
    ):
        put("transaction_charged_twice", 37)
    if h(r"statement|transaction history|list of transactions") and h(
        r"extra charge|additional charge|unexpected charge|"
        r"more than|higher than|different amount|overcharged|"
        r"charged more|extra transaction"
    ):
        put("extra_charge_on_statement", 32)
    if card_payment and h(
        r"extra charge|additional charge|overcharged|"
        r"charged more|different amount|higher amount"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or unrecognized):
        put("extra_charge_on_statement", 29)
    if card_payment and declined:

    if atm and declined:
        put("declined_cash_withdrawal", 35)
    if card_payment and pending:
        put("pending_card_payment", 32)
    if atm and pending:
        put("pending_cash_withdrawal", 34)
    if card_payment and reversed_:
        put("reverted_card_payment", 34)
    if card_payment and fee and not (rate or exchange):
        put("card_payment_fee_charged", 31)
    if card_payment and rate:
        put("card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate", 34)
    if atm and rate:
        put("wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal", 35)
    if atm and fee and not rate:
        put("cash_withdrawal_charge", 34)
    if atm and h(
        r"wrong amount|incorrect amount|less cash|too little cash|"
        r"did not dispense (?:all|the full|enough)|"
        r"only dispensed|received less|cash (?:was|is) short|"
        r"money (?:was|is) missing from (?:the )?atm"
    ):
        put("wrong_amount_of_cash_received", 37)
    if atm and h(r"did not (?:receive|get) (?:any |the )?cash|"
                 r"no cash (?:came out|dispensed)") and not unrecognized:
        put("wrong_amount_of_cash_received", 34)

    # Refunds: requesting one differs from waiting for an already-issued refund.
    refund = h(r"refund|reimbursement|money back|return my money")
    if refund and h(
        r"not (?:showing|arrived|received|credited)|"
        r"has not (?:arrived|shown|appeared|been credited)|"
        r"still waiting|where is|when will (?:it|my refund)|"
        r"missing|not in (?:my|the) account|"
        r"merchant (?:sent|issued|processed|approved)|"
        r"refund (?:pending|processing|taking)"
    ):
        put("refund_not_showing_up", 36)
    if refund and h(
        r"request|ask for|want|need|how (?:do|can|to)|"
        r"get (?:a |my |the )?refund|claim|entitled|"
        r"cancel (?:a |my |the )?purchase|return (?:an |a |the )?item"
    ):
        put("request_refund", 28)
    if refund and "refund_not_showing_up" not in scores:
        put("request_refund", 23)

    # Adding money, including funding methods and funding failures.
    funding_card = topup and h(
        r"by card|with (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"
        r"using (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"
        r"from (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"
        r"card to (?:top up|add money)|debit card|credit card"
    )
    funding_bank = topup and h(
        r"bank transfer|wire|bank account|from (?:my |a |the )?bank|"
        r"via (?:the |a )?bank|iban"
    )
    if deposit_cash and h(
        r"top up|topping up|deposit|pay in|paid in|add|load|"
        r"fund|recharge|can i|how do i"
    ):
        put("top_up_by_cash_or_cheque", 31)
    if funding_bank and fee:
        put("top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge", 35)
    if funding_card and fee:
        put("top_up_by_card_charge", 35)
    if topup and h(
        r"automatic|automatically|auto top up|auto reload|"
        r"recurring|scheduled|when (?:my |the )?balance (?:is|gets) low|"
        r"regular(?:ly)? (?:add|top up)"
    ):
        put("automatic_top_up", 35)
    if topup and h(
        r"limit|maximum|max|minimum|how much|"
        r"how many (?:times|top ups)|per day|per week|per month|"
        r"allowed to (?:top up|add)"
    ):
        put("top_up_limits", 33)
    if topup and reversed_:
        put("top_up_reverted", 35)
    if topup and declined:
        put("top_up_failed", 32)
    if topup and failed:
        put("top_up_failed", 30)
    if topup and pending:
        put("pending_top_up", 34)
    if topup and missing and not (reversed_ or failed or declined):
        put("pending_top_up", 31)
    if funding_card and h(
        r"how|can i|could i|want|need|using|with|by|"
        r"add money|top up|topping up"
    ):
        put("topping_up_by_card", 25 if fee else 30)
    if topup and h(r"card") and not (
        funding_bank or deposit_cash or fee or failed or declined or pending
        or reversed_ or missing
    ):
        put("topping_up_by_card", 21)

    # Transfers: direction, beneficiary, and transaction status are separate.
    if transfer and h(
        r"cancel|stop|recall|undo|withdraw (?:my |the )?transfer|"
        r"reverse (?:my |the )?transfer"
    ) and not reversed_:
        put("cancel_transfer", 35)
    if h(r"beneficiar(?:y|ies)|recipient|payee") and h(
        r"not allowed|cannot|can not|unable|blocked|prohibited|"
        r"not permitted|not eligible|not accepted|"
        r"can not add|cannot add|unable to add"
    ):
        put("beneficiary_not_allowed", 35)
    if transfer and declined:
        put("declined_transfer", 32)
    if transfer and failed:
        put("failed_transfer", 31)
    if transfer and pending:
        put("pending_transfer", 34)
    if transfer and fee and not topup:
        put("transfer_fee_charged", 33)
    if transfer and time and not pending:
        put("transfer_timing", 32)
    if transfer and recipient and h(
        r"not (?:received|arrived|gotten|got|showing)|"
        r"has not (?:received|arrived|got|come)|"
        r"did not (?:receive|get|arrive)|where is|"
        r"missing|still waiting|not reached"
    ):
        put("transfer_not_received_by_recipient", 36)
    if transfer and recipient and missing and not incoming:
        put("transfer_not_received_by_recipient", 32)

    bank_received = h(
        r"bank transfer|wire transfer|transferred (?:money|funds)|"
        r"transfer (?:to|into) (?:my|the|our) account|"
        r"payment from (?:my |the |a )?bank|incoming transfer"
    )
    balance = h(
        r"balance|account|funds|money|available amount|"
        r"transaction history|statement"
    )
    not_updated = h(
        r"not updated|has not updated|did not update|"
        r"not (?:showing|appearing|reflected|credited|there)|"
        r"has not (?:shown|appeared|been credited|arrived)|"
        r"did not (?:show|appear|arrive)|"
        r"missing|where is|not in (?:my|the) account|"
        r"balance (?:is|has) (?:still|not)"
    )
    if bank_received and balance and not_updated and not recipient:
        put("balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer", 36)
    if deposit_cash and balance and not_updated:
        put("balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit", 37)
    if transfer and incoming and h(
        r"how|can i|could i|want|need|details|iban|"
        r"account number|instructions|receive|someone"
    ) and not (missing or pending or fee or declined or failed):
        put("transfer_into_account", 31)
    if transfer and h(r"into (?:my|the|our) account|incoming transfer") and not (
        missing or pending or fee or declined or failed
    ):
        put("transfer_into_account", 28)
    if h(
        r"receiv(?:e|ing) (?:money|funds|payments?)|"
        r"get (?:money|paid|funds) (?:from|into|sent)|"
        r"someone (?:pay|send)s? me|someone sending me money|"
        r"being paid|accept (?:money|payments)"
    ) and not (missing or pending or declined or failed):
        put("receiving_money", 26 if transfer else 30)

    # Currency exchange as an action, an advertised rate, or a fee.
    if exchange and fee and not (card_payment or atm or topup or transfer):
        put("exchange_charge", 33)
    if exchange and h(
        r"in (?:the |my )?app|through (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"using (?:the |my )?app|within (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"how (?:do|can|to) (?:i |we )?(?:exchange|convert)|"
        r"exchange (?:money|currenc(?:y|ies))|"
        r"convert (?:money|currenc(?:y|ies))"
    ) and not (fee or rate or card_payment or atm):
        put("exchange_via_app", 29)
    if rate and not (card_payment or atm):
        put("exchange_rate", 32)
    if exchange and h(r"rate|how much (?:will|do) i get|"
                      r"what is (?:the|your) conversion") and not (
        card_payment or atm or fee
    ):
        put("exchange_rate", 29)

    # Prefer a clearly identified problem over a general question about a method.
    if scores:
        best = max(scores.values())
        contenders = [label for label, value in scores.items() if value == best]
        if len(contenders) == 1:
            return {"answer": contenders[0]}
        tie_preferences = (
            "wrong_amount_of_cash_received",
            "transaction_charged_twice",
            "refund_not_showing_up",
            "balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit",
            "balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer",
            "transfer_not_received_by_recipient",
            "virtual_card_not_working",
            "contactless_not_working",
            "declined_cash_withdrawal",
            "declined_card_payment",
            "declined_transfer",
            "failed_transfer",
            "top_up_failed",
            "pending_cash_withdrawal",
            "pending_card_payment",
            "pending_transfer",
            "pending_top_up",
            "card_arrival",
            "card_delivery_estimate",
        )
        for label in tie_preferences:
            if label in contenders:
                return {"answer": label}
        return {"answer": sorted(contenders)[0]}

    # Weak evidence is useful only when no specific intent was established.
    if h(r"refund|money back"):
        return {"answer": "request_refund"}
    if h(r"exchange|conversion|currency rate"):
        return {"answer": "exchange_rate"}
    if atm:
        return {"answer": "atm_support"}
    if transfer:
        return {"answer": "transfer_into_account" if incoming else "transfer_timing"}
    if topup:
        return {"answer": "topping_up_by_card"}
    if virtual:
        return {"answer": "getting_virtual_card"}
    if card:
        return {"answer": "card_not_working"}
    return {"answer": "receiving_money"}

import re
import unicodedata


def _normalize(value):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(value or ""))
    text = "".join(ch for ch in text if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    text = text.lower().replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    text = re.sub(r"\bcan't\b", "can not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bwon't\b", "will not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'s\b", r"\1 is", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'(?:ve|m|d|ll|re)\b", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\btop[\s-]?up\b", "top up", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bmaster[\s-]?card\b", "mastercard", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text)
    return " ".join(text.split())


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    scores = {}

    def has(pattern):
        return re.search(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + pattern + r")(?!\w)", text) is not None

    def close(first, second, distance=85):
        aa = re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + first + r")(?!\w)", text)
        bb = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + second + r")(?!\w)", text))
        return any(
            max(a.start() - b.end(), b.start() - a.end(), 0) <= distance
            for a in aa for b in bb
        )

    def add(label, weight):
        scores[label] = max(scores.get(label, 0), weight)

    card = has(r"cards?|plastic")
    virtual = has(
        r"virtual|digital card|electronic card|e card|"
        r"online only card|online card|internet card"
    )
    disposable = has(
        r"disposable|single use|one time|one use|temporary card|"
        r"throwaway card|one off card"
    )
    physical = has(r"physical|plastic|real card|tangible card")
    cash = has(
        r"atms?|cash ?machines?|cashpoints?|withdraw(?:n|al|als|ing|s)?|"
        r"taking out cash|take out cash|get cash out|"
        r"dispens(?:e|ed|ing)|cash out"
    )
    deposit = has(
        r"cheques?|checks?|cash deposit|deposit(?:ing|ed)? cash|"
        r"pay(?:ing|ed)? in cash|cash paid in|cash into (?:my|the) account"
    )
    topup = has(
        r"top up|topping up|reload(?:ing|ed)?|auto reload|"
        r"recharg(?:e|ed|ing)|"
        r"load(?:ed|ing)? (?:money|funds|cash|my card|the card|"
        r"my account|the account|my balance)|"
        r"add(?:ed|ing)? (?:money|funds|cash|credit) "
        r"(?:to|into|onto|on)?|"
        r"add(?:ed|ing)? (?:money|funds|cash|credit)|"
        r"fund(?:ed|ing)? (?:my|the|an?) (?:balance|account|card)|"
        r"funding (?:my|the) balance|balance (?:reload|recharge)"
    )
    bank_transfer = has(
        r"bank transfer|bank wire|wire transfer|wire payment|"
        r"international transfer|iban|swift|"
        r"from (?:my|another|the|a) bank (?:account )?into"
    )
    send = has(
        r"transfers?|transferr(?:ed|ing)|bank wire|wire payment|"
        r"send(?:ing|s|t)? (?:money|funds|a payment|a transfer)|"
        r"money (?:i|we|was|has been) (?:sent|send|sending)|"
        r"money .{0,35} (?:sent|send|sending)|"
        r"(?:sent|sending|send) (?:it |funds |money )?to (?:my |the |a |another )?"
        r"(?:bank|account|someone|recipient|beneficiary|sister|brother|friend)|"
        r"payment to (?:another|a|the|my) bank account|"
        r"pay(?:ing)? (?:my|the|a) beneficiar(?:y|ies)|"
        r"move money (?:to|between|from)|"
        r"remittance|remit"
    ) or bank_transfer
    direct = has(
        r"direct debit|standing order|bank debit|automatic debit|"
        r"recurring debit|debit instruction"
    )
    incoming = has(
        r"incoming|inbound|into (?:my|the|our) account|"
        r"to (?:my|the|our) account|to me|"
        r"from (?:another|my|the|a) bank (?:account)?|"
        r"someone (?:sent|transferred|paid)|"
        r"receiv(?:e|ed|ing) (?:money|funds|a payment|a transfer)|"
        r"pay(?:ing)? (?:me|into my account)"
    )
    recipient = has(
        r"recipient|beneficiar(?:y|ies)|payee|"
        r"person (?:i|we) (?:sent|paid)|"
        r"(?:my|the) (?:sister|brother|friend|landlord|recipient) "
        r"(?:has not|did not|still has not)|"
        r"(?:they|he|she) (?:have not|has not|did not) (?:receive|get)|"
        r"their (?:bank |)account|his account|her account|"
        r"other person|other account"
    )
    purchase = has(
        r"purchas(?:e|ed|ing)|merchant|retailer|shop|store|"
        r"checkout|point of sale|pos terminal|"
        r"paid (?:at|in|for|with)|buy(?:ing|ought)?|"
        r"hotel|restaurant|supermarket|card payment|card transaction"
    )
    card_payment = (
        has(r"card payment|card transaction|payment (?:on|with|using) (?:my |the )?card")
        or (card and close(r"cards?", r"payments?|paid|purchas(?:e|ed|ing)|"
                                           r"charges?|transactions?|merchant"))
        or (purchase and not (send or topup or cash or direct))
        or (
            has(r"payments?|transactions?|charged")
            and not (send or topup or cash or direct or deposit)
            and has(r"card|merchant|shop|store|purchase")
        )
    )
    fee = has(
        r"fees?|surcharges?|commissions?|service charges?|"
        r"extra (?:charge|cost|amount)|additional (?:charge|cost|amount)|"
        r"charged extra|billed extra|billed (?:a |an )?(?:fee|charge)|"
        r"cost (?:me|anything|extra)|costs? to|"
        r"charged (?:me )?(?:a |an )?(?:fee|commission)|"
        r"deduct(?:ed|ing)? (?:a |an )?(?:fee|charge)|"
        r"pay (?:a |an )?(?:fee|charge)|"
        r"how much does it cost|does it cost|"
        r"charges? (?:for|on) (?:a |the |my )?"
        r"(?:transfer|withdrawal|top up|card payment|exchange)"
    )
    rate = has(
        r"exchange rates?|conversion rates?|currency rates?|"
        r"fx rates?|forex rates?|rate of exchange|"
        r"wrong rate|bad rate|different rate|"
        r"converted .{0,55} at (?:a|the) rate|"
        r"rate .{0,40} (?:expected|quoted|advertised)"
    )
    exchange = has(
        r"exchang(?:e|ing|ed)|convert(?:ing|ed|s)?|conversion|"
        r"swap(?:ping)? (?:currenc(?:y|ies)|money)|fx|forex|"
        r"chang(?:e|ing|ed) (?:my |the |a )?(?:currency|"
        r"balance from|money from)|"
        r"currency balance into another|one currency .{0,20} another"
    )
    unknown = has(
        r"do not recogni[sz]e|not recogni[sz]e|unrecogni[sz]ed|"
        r"do not know (?:what|who)|unknown|unfamiliar|"
        r"not mine|not my (?:payment|transaction|withdrawal|charge)|"
        r"never (?:made|did|authori[sz]ed|withdrew|bought|paid|visited)|"
        r"did not (?:make|authori[sz]e|withdraw|pay|buy)|"
        r"unauthori[sz]ed|fraudulent|suspicious (?:charge|payment|transaction)|"
        r"who (?:made|authori[sz]ed|charged) (?:this|the)"
    )
    declined = has(
        r"declin(?:e|ed|ing)|reject(?:ed|ion|ing)?|"
        r"refus(?:ed|al)|denied|not accepted|would not accept|"
        r"not allowed|would not let me|will not let me"
    )
    failed = has(
        r"fail(?:ed|ing|ure|s)?|unsuccessful|"
        r"error (?:message|code|screen)|get an error|"
        r"did not go through|never went through|"
        r"has not gone through|could not go through|"
        r"not going through|would not go through|"
        r"did not work|does not work|not working|"
        r"cannot (?:send|transfer|top up|add funds)|"
        r"can not (?:send|transfer|top up|add funds)|"
        r"unable to (?:send|transfer|top up|add funds)|"
        r"could not (?:complete|process|send|transfer)"
    )
    pending = has(
        r"pending|processing|in progress|on hold|stuck|"
        r"still waiting|awaiting|authorization|authorisation|"
        r"not (?:yet )?(?:completed|complete|finali[sz]ed|posted|cleared)|"
        r"taking (?:so )?long to (?:process|complete|clear)|"
        r"waiting (?:to|for it to) (?:clear|complete|post)"
    )
    reverted = has(
        r"revert(?:ed|ing)?|revers(?:ed|al|ing)|"
        r"bounced back|sent back|returned (?:to my|to the|back to)|"
        r"disappear(?:ed|ing)? (?:again|after)|"
        r"money (?:was|has been) (?:taken back|returned)"
    )
    missing = has(
        r"not (?:showing|appearing|visible|there|arrived|received|credited|reflected)|"
        r"has not (?:shown|appeared|arrived|come|been credited|updated|changed)|"
        r"have not (?:received|gotten|seen)|"
        r"did not (?:show|appear|arrive|receive|get credited)|"
        r"still (?:not|missing)|missing|where is|"
        r"no sign of|not in (?:my|the) account|not reflected|"
        r"balance (?:has not|have not|did not) (?:change|update)|"
        r"balance (?:is|remains) (?:unchanged|the same)"
    )
    time = has(
        r"how long|when (?:will|does|do|should|can|would)|"
        r"how (?:fast|soon|quickly)|time(?:frame|scale)?|"
        r"how many (?:days|hours|weeks)|estimated|estimate|eta|"
        r"delivery date|arrival date"
    )
    instructions = has(
        r"how (?:do|can|could|would|should|to)|where (?:can|do|to)|"
        r"want to|would like to|need to|trying to|can i|could i"
    )

    # Account access, security, and identity.
    if has(r"phone|mobile|handset|smartphone|device") and has(
        r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"
    ) and close(
        r"phone|mobile|handset|smartphone|device",
        r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"
    ):
        add("lost_or_stolen_phone", 96)
    if card and has(
        r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"
    ) and close(
        r"cards?|plastic",
        r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"
    ):
        add("lost_or_stolen_card", 86)
    if card and has(
        r"compromised|cloned|skimmed|"
        r"(?:card (?:details|information|number)|pin) "
        r"(?:stolen|leaked|exposed|shared)|"
        r"gave .{0,35} (?:card number|card details|pin)|"
        r"someone (?:has|knows|got) my card|"
        r"stranger .{0,35} (?:card|pin)|"
        r"card (?:security|information) (?:breach|leak)|"
        r"secure (?:my|the) card"
    ):
        add("compromised_card", 97)
    if has(r"passcode|pass code|app pin|login pin|login code|access code") and has(
        r"forgot|forgotten|cannot remember|can not remember|"
        r"do not remember|lost|reset|recover"
    ):
        add("passcode_forgotten", 91)
    if has(r"pin|pin number") and has(
        r"blocked|locked|too many (?:attempts|tries)|"
        r"(?:several|multiple|too many) (?:failed|wrong) (?:entries|attempts|tries)|"
        r"after .{0,25} (?:failed|wrong) (?:entries|attempts|tries)|"
        r"unblock|unlock"
    ):
        add("pin_blocked", 94)
    if has(r"pin|pin number") and has(
        r"change|reset|update|new pin|choose|set|forgot|remember"
    ):
        add("change_pin", 81)
    if has(
        r"personal details|personal information|profile|account settings|"
        r"address|phone number|email|legal name|surname|date of birth"
    ) and has(
        r"change|edit|update|correct|modify|replace|wrong|new|move|moved"
    ):
        add("edit_personal_details", 87)
    if has(r"account") and has(
        r"close|closure|terminate|delete|deactivate|shut down|"
        r"cancel my account|stop using|permanently remove"
    ):
        add("terminate_account", 91)
    if has(
        r"age|years old|birthday|minor|underage|under 18|"
        r"turn 18|over 18|old enough|son|daughter|child|teenager"
    ) and has(
        r"minimum|limit|requirement|eligible|old enough|"
        r"open|account|card|join|sign up|register|allowed"
    ):
        add("age_limit", 91)

    identity = has(
        r"identit(?:y|ies)|id|id document|passport|driver(?:s)? licen[cs]e|"
        r"selfie|know your customer|kyc|verification"
    )
    verifying = has(
        r"verif(?:y|ication|ied)|confirm|prove|validate|identification|"
        r"submit (?:my|an?) (?:id|passport|selfie)|upload (?:my|an?) "
        r"(?:id|passport|selfie)"
    )
    if has(
        r"source of funds|source of wealth|proof of funds|"
        r"origin of (?:my |the )?(?:funds|money)|"
        r"where (?:my |the )?money (?:came|comes) from|"
        r"prove where (?:my |the )?money|"
        r"verify (?:my |the )?(?:income|earnings)"
    ):
        add("verify_source_of_funds", 98)
    if identity and has(
        r"cannot|can not|unable|trouble|problem|keeps failing|"
        r"rejected|not accepted|does not work|unsuccessful|stuck|"
        r"documents? (?:rejected|failed)|verification failed|"
        r"will not verify"
    ):
        add("unable_to_verify_identity", 95)
    if identity and has(
        r"why|reason|necessary|have to|need to|"
        r"required|requirement|what for|purpose|"
        r"why .{0,45} (?:selfie|passport|id|verification)"
    ):
        add("why_verify_identity", 92)
    if identity and (verifying or has(r"submit|upload|documents?")):
        add("verify_my_identity", 75)
    if topup and verifying and not identity:
        add("verify_top_up", 88)
    if has(r"top up verification|verify (?:a |my |the )?top up"):
        add("verify_top_up", 94)

    # Card type, acquisition, and operation.
    if has(
        r"apple pay|google pay|apple wallet|google wallet|"
        r"apple .{0,20} wallet|google .{0,20} wallet|"
        r"gpay|pay with (?:my )?(?:iphone|android|phone)|"
        r"add (?:my |the )?card to (?:my )?(?:iphone|phone wallet)"
    ):
        add("apple_pay_or_google_pay", 96)
    if has(r"visa|mastercard|master card|payment network|card network") and has(
        r"card|visa|mastercard|network|which|do you|is it"
    ):
        add("visa_or_mastercard", 87)
    if card and has(
        r"activat(?:e|ion|ed|ing)|enable (?:my |the )?card|"
        r"start using (?:my |the )?(?:new )?card|"
        r"(?:make|set) (?:it|my card|the card) ready to use"
    ):
        add("activate_my_card", 92)
    if card and has(
        r"expir(?:e|es|ed|ing|y|ation)|valid until|valid thru|"
        r"out of date|renew(?:al|ed)?"
    ):
        add("card_about_to_expire", 92)
    if card and has(
        r"link(?:ed|ing)?|connect(?:ed|ing)?|attach(?:ed|ing)?|"
        r"pair(?:ed|ing)?|add (?:it|my card|the card) to (?:my|the) "

    ) and has(r"account|app|card"):
        add("card_linking", 88)
    if card and has(
        r"swallowed|eaten|kept my card|retained my card|"
        r"atm (?:took|kept|ate)|card (?:stuck|trapped) in "
        r"(?:an? )?(?:atm|machine)"
    ):
        add("card_swallowed", 99)
    if card and has(
        r"spare|backup|replacement|replace my card|replace the card|"
        r"another card|second card|extra card|additional card|"

    ) and has(
        r"get|order|request|need|want|send|replace|obtain|"
        r"how|while keeping|alongside"
    ):
        add("getting_spare_card", 85)
    if disposable and (card or has(r"card numbers?")) and has(
        r"limit|maximum|max|how many|number of|cap|reached|"
        r"how often|frequency|per day|per month|restriction"
    ):
        add("disposable_card_limits", 94)
    if disposable and (card or virtual) and has(
        r"get|create|generate|make|obtain|request|order|"
        r"how|where|want|need|available"
    ):
        add("get_disposable_virtual_card", 83)
    if virtual and card and has(
        r"not working|does not work|did not work|cannot use|can not use|"
        r"declined|rejected|failed|problem|issue|unable to (?:use|pay)|"
        r"not accepted"
    ):
        add("virtual_card_not_working", 91)
    if virtual and card and has(
        r"get|create|generate|obtain|order|request|set up|"
        r"how|where|want|need|available|apply|looking for"
    ):
        add("getting_virtual_card", 74 if disposable else 83)
    if physical and card and has(
        r"order|request|apply for|place an order"
    ) and not has(r"replacement|replace|spare|backup"):
        add("order_physical_card", 84)
    if physical and card and has(
        r"get|obtain|receive|how|where|want|need|available|"
        r"can i have|send me"
    ) and not has(r"replacement|replace|spare|backup"):
        add("get_physical_card", 75 if has(r"order|request") else 82)

    delivery = card and has(
        r"deliver(?:y|ed|ing)?|arriv(?:e|ed|al|ing)|"
        r"ship(?:ped|ping|ment)?|post(?:ed|age)?|mail(?:ed|ing)?|"
        r"dispatch(?:ed)?|come in the post|on its way|"
        r"reach (?:me|my address)|get (?:here|to me)"
    )
    if delivery and time:
        add("card_delivery_estimate", 83)
    if delivery and has(
        r"not (?:yet )?(?:arrived|delivered|received|come)|"
        r"has not (?:arrived|come|been delivered)|"
        r"still waiting|where is|track|lost in (?:the )?post|"
        r"late|overdue|never (?:arrived|came)|missing"
    ):
        add("card_arrival", 89)
    if delivery and not time:
        add("card_arrival", 65)
    if card and has(
        r"where (?:can|will) (?:i|my card) (?:use|pay|work)|"
        r"accept(?:ed|ance)?|use (?:my |the )?card (?:in|at|abroad)|"
        r"which (?:shops|stores|merchants|places)|"
        r"can (?:i |we )?(?:pay|purchase|buy) (?:with|using) "
        r"(?:my |the )?card"
    ) and not (declined or failed):
        add("card_acceptance", 72)
    if has(
        r"contactless|tap to pay|tap and pay|nfc|paywave|paypass|"
        r"tap (?:my |the )?card"
    ) and (
        failed or declined or has(
            r"not working|cannot|can not|unable|problem|issue|"
            r"will not|stopped|does not|not going through"
        )
    ):
        add("contactless_not_working", 96)
    if card and has(
        r"not working|does not work|did not work|cannot use|can not use|"
        r"unable to use|card is broken|card stopped working|"
        r"problem with (?:my |the )?card|card does not function|"
        r"card is faulty|stopped working"
    ):
        add("card_not_working", 70 if virtual else 77)

    # Availability and supported payment facilities.
    if has(r"atm|cash machine|cashpoint") and has(
        r"which|where|support|compatible|use|work|available|"
        r"network|find|accept|withdraw"
    ) and not (failed or declined or fee or pending or unknown):
        add("atm_support", 66)
    if has(
        r"countries|country|region|territor(?:y|ies)|"
        r"nationalit(?:y|ies)|resident|residency|"
        r"where i live|available where|available in"
    ) and has(
        r"support|available|eligible|open an account|sign up|"
        r"operate|service|join|live in|based in|which|what|where"
    ) and not (card and has(r"use|accepted|work|pay")):
        add("country_support", 79)
    if has(r"currenc(?:y|ies)|fiat|dollars?|euros?|pounds?|gbp|usd|eur") and has(
        r"support|available|which|what|hold|account|add|use|accepted|list"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or fee):
        add("fiat_currency_support", 72)
    if card and has(r"currenc(?:y|ies)|fiat|visa|mastercard") and has(
        r"support|accepted|eligible|which|what|"
        r"top up|use to add|can i use"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or fee):
        add("supported_cards_and_currencies", 76)

    # Transaction identity, discrepancies, and card payments.
    if direct and unknown:
        add("direct_debit_payment_not_recognised", 99)
    if cash and unknown:
        add("cash_withdrawal_not_recognised", 96)
    if card_payment and unknown and not direct and not cash:
        add("card_payment_not_recognised", 94)
    if unknown and has(r"payment|purchase|transaction|charge") and not (
        cash or direct or send or topup
    ):
        add("card_payment_not_recognised", 87)
    if has(
        r"charged twice|charged (?:me )?(?:two|2) times|"
        r"double charged|duplicate (?:charge|payment|transaction|debit)|"
        r"(?:same|one) (?:payment|purchase|transaction|charge) .{0,30} twice|"
        r"(?:payment|purchase|transaction|charge) appears? twice|"
        r"appears? twice .{0,35} (?:statement|payment|purchase)|"
        r"debited twice|paid twice|two identical (?:charges|payments)"
    ):
        add("transaction_charged_twice", 99)
    if has(r"statement|transaction history|list of transactions") and has(
        r"extra charge|additional charge|unexpected charge|"
        r"more than|higher than|different amount|overcharged|"
        r"charged more|extra transaction|strange charge"
    ):
        add("extra_charge_on_statement", 91)
    if card_payment and has(
        r"extra charge|additional charge|overcharged|"
        r"charged more|different amount|higher amount"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or unknown):
        add("extra_charge_on_statement", 81)
    if card_payment and declined and not send:
        add("declined_card_payment", 89)
    if cash and declined:
        add("declined_cash_withdrawal", 93)
    if card_payment and pending:
        add("pending_card_payment", 86)
    if cash and pending:
        add("pending_cash_withdrawal", 91)
    if card_payment and reverted:
        add("reverted_card_payment", 93)
    if card_payment and fee and not (rate or exchange or topup):
        add("card_payment_fee_charged", 90)
    if card_payment and rate:
        add("card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate", 95)
    if cash and rate:
        add("wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal", 96)
    if cash and fee and not rate:
        add("cash_withdrawal_charge", 94)
    if cash and has(
        r"wrong amount|incorrect amount|less cash|too little cash|"
        r"did not dispense (?:all|the full|enough)|"
        r"only dispensed|dispensed .{0,20} instead of|"
        r"asked for .{0,45} dispensed|"
        r"received less|cash (?:was|is) short|"
        r"missing notes|missing banknotes|"
        r"did not (?:receive|get) (?:any |the )?cash|"
        r"no cash (?:came out|dispensed)"
    ) and not unknown:
        add("wrong_amount_of_cash_received", 98)

    refund = has(r"refund|reimbursement|money back|return my money")
    if refund and has(
        r"not (?:showing|arrived|received|credited)|"
        r"has not (?:arrived|shown|appeared|been credited|changed)|"
        r"still waiting|where is|when will (?:it|my refund)|"
        r"missing|not in (?:my|the) account|"
        r"(?:merchant|seller|shop|airline) .{0,25}"
        r"(?:sent|issued|processed|approved)|"
        r"refund (?:pending|processing|taking)|"
        r"balance (?:has not|did not|have not) chang"
    ):
        add("refund_not_showing_up", 96)
    if refund and has(
        r"request|ask for|want|need|how (?:do|can|to)|"
        r"get (?:a |my |the )?refund|claim|entitled|"
        r"cancel (?:a |my |the )?purchase|"
        r"return (?:an |a |the )?item|where do i start"
    ):
        add("request_refund", 79)
    if refund and "refund_not_showing_up" not in scores:
        add("request_refund", 66)

    # Funding: identify the source separately from the status.
    funding_card = topup and has(
        r"by card|with (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"
        r"using (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"
        r"from (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"
        r"card to (?:top up|add money)|debit card|credit card"
    )
    funding_bank = topup and has(
        r"bank transfer|wire|bank account|from (?:my |a |the )?bank|"
        r"via (?:the |a )?bank|iban"
    )
    if deposit and has(
        r"top up|topping up|deposit|pay in|paid in|add|load|"
        r"fund|recharge|can i|how do i"
    ):
        add("top_up_by_cash_or_cheque", 82)
    if funding_bank and fee:
        add("top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge", 96)
    if funding_card and fee:
        add("top_up_by_card_charge", 96)
    if (topup or has(r"amount added|money added|funds added")) and has(
        r"automatic|automatically|auto top up|auto reload|"
        r"recurring|scheduled|balance (?:runs|gets|is) low|"
        r"balance falls below|when (?:my |the )?balance "
        r"(?:is|gets|runs) low|regular(?:ly)? (?:add|top up)"
    ):
        add("automatic_top_up", 95)
    if topup and has(
        r"limit|maximum|max|minimum|how much|cap|"
        r"how many (?:times|top ups)|per day|per week|per month|"
        r"allowed to (?:top up|add)"
    ):
        add("top_up_limits", 89)
    if topup and reverted:
        add("top_up_reverted", 95)
    if topup and (declined or failed):
        add("top_up_failed", 89)
    if topup and pending:
        add("pending_top_up", 88)
    if topup and missing and not (reverted or failed or declined):
        add("pending_top_up", 82)
    if funding_card and (
        instructions or has(r"using|with|by|add money|top up|topping up")
    ):
        add("topping_up_by_card", 69 if fee else 80)
    if topup and card and not (
        funding_bank or deposit or fee or failed or declined or
        pending or reverted or missing
    ):
        add("topping_up_by_card", 66)

    # Transfers, destination, and completion.
    if send and has(
        r"cancel|stop|recall|undo|withdraw (?:my |the )?"
        r"(?:transfer|instruction)|"
        r"reverse (?:my |the )?transfer|"
        r"no longer want .{0,35} transfer"
    ) and not reverted:
        add("cancel_transfer", 94)
    if has(r"beneficiar(?:y|ies)|recipient|payee") and has(
        r"not allowed|cannot|can not|unable|blocked|prohibited|"
        r"not permitted|not eligible|not accepted|"
        r"cannot add|can not add|unable to add|"
        r"not letting me add"
    ):
        add("beneficiary_not_allowed", 94)
    if send and declined and not funding_card:
        add("declined_transfer", 91)
    if send and failed and not topup:
        add("failed_transfer", 88)
    if send and pending and not topup:
        add("pending_transfer", 86)
    if send and fee and not topup:
        add("transfer_fee_charged", 92)
    if send and time and not pending and not (failed or declined):
        add("transfer_timing", 74)
    if send and recipient and has(
        r"not (?:received|arrived|gotten|got|showing)|"
        r"has not (?:received|arrived|got|come)|"
        r"did not (?:receive|get|arrive)|where is|"
        r"missing|still waiting|not reached"
    ):
        add("transfer_not_received_by_recipient", 96)
    if send and recipient and missing and not incoming:
        add("transfer_not_received_by_recipient", 88)

    balance = has(
        r"balance|account|funds|money|available amount|"
        r"transaction history|statement"
    )
    not_updated = missing or has(
        r"not updated|has not updated|did not update|"
        r"balance .{0,25} (?:unchanged|same)|"
        r"money .{0,25} not .{0,15} (?:there|credited)"
    )
    if bank_transfer and balance and not_updated and not recipient:
        add("balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer", 96)
    if deposit and balance and not_updated:
        add("balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit", 97)
    if bank_transfer and incoming and (
        instructions or has(r"details|iban|account number|instructions")
    ) and not (missing or pending or fee or declined or failed):
        add("transfer_into_account", 86)
    if send and has(
        r"into (?:my|the|our) account|incoming transfer|"
        r"from (?:my|another|the) bank .{0,30} (?:this|my|the) account"
    ) and not (missing or pending or fee or declined or failed):
        add("transfer_into_account", 81)
    if has(
        r"receiv(?:e|ing) (?:money|funds|payments?)|"
        r"get (?:money|paid|funds) (?:from|into|sent)|"
        r"someone (?:pay|send)s? me|someone sending me money|"
        r"being paid|accept (?:money|payments)"
    ) and not (missing or pending or declined or failed):
        add("receiving_money", 64 if send else 76)

    # Rates, conversion services, and conversion fees.
    if exchange and fee and not (card_payment or cash or topup or send):
        add("exchange_charge", 94)
    if exchange and has(
        r"in (?:the |my )?app|through (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"using (?:the |my )?app|within (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"which menu|where in (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"how (?:do|can|to) (?:i |we )?(?:exchange|convert)|"
        r"exchange (?:money|currenc(?:y|ies))|"
        r"convert (?:money|currenc(?:y|ies))|"
        r"currency balance into another"
    ) and not (fee or rate or card_payment or cash):
        add("exchange_via_app", 83)
    if rate and not (card_payment or cash):
        add("exchange_rate", 86)
    if exchange and has(
        r"rate|how much (?:will|do) i get|"
        r"what is (?:the|your) conversion"
    ) and not (card_payment or cash or fee):
        add("exchange_rate", 80)

    if scores:
        highest = max(scores.values())
        tied = [label for label, weight in scores.items() if weight == highest]
        if len(tied) == 1:
            return {"answer": tied[0]}
        preference = (
            "card_swallowed", "transaction_charged_twice",
            "wrong_amount_of_cash_received",
            "refund_not_showing_up",
            "balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit",
            "balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer",
            "transfer_not_received_by_recipient",
            "compromised_card", "contactless_not_working",
            "virtual_card_not_working", "declined_cash_withdrawal",
            "declined_transfer", "declined_card_payment",
            "failed_transfer", "top_up_failed", "pending_cash_withdrawal",
            "pending_transfer", "pending_top_up", "pending_card_payment",
            "card_arrival", "card_delivery_estimate",
        )
        for label in preference:
            if label in tied:
                return {"answer": label}
        return {"answer": sorted(tied)[0]}

    if refund:
        return {"answer": "request_refund"}
    if rate or exchange:
        return {"answer": "exchange_rate"}
    if cash:
        return {"answer": "atm_support"}
    if send:
        return {"answer": "transfer_into_account" if incoming else "transfer_timing"}
    if topup:
        return {"answer": "topping_up_by_card"}
    if virtual:
        return {"answer": "getting_virtual_card"}
    if card:
        return {"answer": "card_not_working"}
    return {"answer": "receiving_money"}

import re
import unicodedata


def _normalize(value):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(value or "")).lower()
    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    text = text.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    for old, new in (
        ("can't", "can not"),
        ("cannot", "can not"),
        ("won't", "will not"),
        ("shan't", "shall not"),
    ):
        text = text.replace(old, new)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)
    for ending, replacement in (
        ("'s", " is"),
        ("'ve", " have"),
        ("'re", " are"),
        ("'m", " am"),
        ("'ll", " will"),
        ("'d", " would"),
    ):
        text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)" + ending + r"\b", r"\1" + replacement, text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(?:topp(?:ed|ing)\s+up|top[\s-]?ups?)\b", "top up", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bmaster[\s-]?card\b", "mastercard", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text)
    return " ".join(text.split())


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    scores = {}

    def h(pattern):
        return re.search(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + pattern + r")(?!\w)", text) is not None

    def near(a, b, gap=85):
        left = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + a + r")(?!\w)", text))
        right = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + b + r")(?!\w)", text))
        return any(
            max(x.start() - y.end(), y.start() - x.end(), 0) <= gap
            for x in left for y in right
        )

    def add(label, strength):
        scores[label] = max(scores.get(label, 0), strength)

    card = h(r"cards?|plastic")
    physical = h(r"physical|plastic|real card|card (?:i can )?carry|"
                 r"card for (?:my |the )?wallet")
    virtual = h(r"virtual|digital card|electronic card|e card|"
                r"online only card|online card|card details in (?:the |my )?app")
    disposable = h(r"disposable|single use|one time|one use|temporary card|"
                   r"throwaway card|card number (?:that )?changes|"
                   r"changes after each use")
    cash = h(r"atms?|cash ?machines?|cashpoints?|withdraw(?:n|al|als|ing|s)?|"
             r"take out cash|taking out cash|take out money|"
             r"cash out|dispens(?:e|ed|ing)|cash withdrawal")
    deposit = h(r"cheques?|checks?|cash deposit|deposit(?:ing|ed)? cash|"
                r"pay(?:ing|ed)? in cash|paid in|cash into (?:my|the) account")
    topup = h(
        r"top up|reload(?:ing|ed)?|recharg(?:e|ed|ing)|"
        r"refill(?:ing|ed)? (?:my |the |an? )?(?:account|balance|card)|"
        r"(?:account|balance|card) (?:refill|reload)|"
        r"load(?:ed|ing)? (?:money|funds|cash|my card|the card|"
        r"my account|the account|my balance|into)|"
        r"add(?:ed|ing)? (?:money|funds|cash|credit|to (?:my|the) balance)|"
        r"fund(?:ed|ing)? (?:my|the|an?) (?:balance|account|card)|"
        r"funding (?:my|the) balance|"
        r"put (?:money|funds|cash|[0-9]+) into (?:my|the|this) account|"
        r"put money on (?:my|the) card|"
        r"money (?:onto|into) (?:my|the) (?:card|balance)"
    )
    bank = h(r"bank transfer|bank wire|wire transfer|wire payment|"
             r"international transfer|iban|swift")
    transfer = bank or h(
        r"transfers?|transferr(?:ed|ing)|remittance|remit|"
        r"send(?:ing|s|t)? (?:money|funds|a payment|a transfer)|"
        r"money (?:i|we|was|has been) sent|"
        r"(?:send|sent|sending) .{0,35} to (?:another|a|the|my|her|his|their) "
        r"(?:bank|account)|"
        r"payment to (?:another|a|the|my) bank account|"
        r"pay(?:ing)? (?:my|the|a) beneficiar(?:y|ies)|"
        r"move money (?:to|between|from)|money i am sending"
    )
    direct = h(r"direct debit|standing order|bank debit|automatic debit|"
               r"recurring debit|debit instruction")
    recipient = h(
        r"recipient|beneficiar(?:y|ies)|payee|"
        r"person (?:i|we) (?:sent|paid)|person i paid|"
        r"(?:my|the) (?:sister|brother|friend|landlord) "
        r"(?:has not|did not|still has not)|"
        r"(?:they|he|she) (?:have not|has not|did not) (?:receive|get)|"
        r"their (?:bank )?account|his account|her account|"
        r"other person|other account"
    )
    incoming = h(
        r"incoming|inbound|into (?:my|the|our|this) account|"
        r"from (?:another|my|the|a) bank|"
        r"someone (?:sent|transferred|paid)|"
        r"receiv(?:e|ed|ing) (?:money|funds|a payment|a transfer)|"
        r"pay(?:ing)? (?:me|into my account)"
    )
    purchase = h(
        r"purchas(?:e|ed|ing)|merchant|retailer|shop|store|"
        r"checkout|point of sale|pos terminal|"
        r"paid (?:at|in|for|with)|buy(?:ing|ought)?|"
        r"hotel|restaurant|supermarket|card payment|card transaction"
    )
    card_payment = (
        h(r"card payment|card transaction|payment (?:on|with|using) "
          r"(?:my |the )?card")
        or (card and near(r"cards?", r"payments?|paid|purchas(?:e|ed|ing)|"
                                      r"charges?|transactions?|merchant"))
        or (purchase and not (transfer or topup or cash or direct))
        or (
            h(r"payments?|transactions?|charged")
            and h(r"card|merchant|shop|store|purchase")
            and not (transfer or topup or cash or direct)
        )
    )
    fee = h(
        r"fees?|surcharges?|commissions?|service charges?|"
        r"processing (?:charge|fee)|extra (?:charge|cost|amount)|"
        r"additional (?:charge|cost|amount)|charged extra|billed extra|"
        r"billed (?:a |an )?(?:fee|charge)|cost (?:me|anything|extra)|"
        r"costs? to|does it cost|charged (?:me )?(?:a |an )?(?:fee|commission)|"
        r"deduct(?:ed|ing)? (?:a |an )?(?:fee|charge)|"
