        r"not updated|has not updated|did not update|"
        r"balance .{0,25} (?:unchanged|same)|"
        r"when will (?:my |the )?balance (?:reflect|show|update)|"
        r"balance .{0,25} (?:reflect|show|credit)|"
        r"not (?:yet )?(?:in|on) (?:my|the) balance"
    )
    if bank and balance and balance_issue and not recipient:
        add("balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer", 104)
    if deposit and balance and balance_issue:
        add("balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit", 105)
    if bank and incoming and (
        how or h(r"details|iban|account number|instructions")
    ) and not (missing or pending or fee or declined or failed):
        add("transfer_into_account", 92)
    if transfer and h(
        r"into (?:my|the|our|this) account|incoming transfer|"
        r"from (?:my|another|the) bank .{0,30} (?:this|my|the) account"
    ) and not (missing or pending or fee or declined or failed):
        add("transfer_into_account", 86)
    if h(
        r"receiv(?:e|ing) (?:money|funds|payments?)|"
        r"get (?:money|paid|funds) (?:from|into|sent)|"
        r"someone (?:pay|send)s? me|someone sending me money|"
        r"(?:friend|person) send money (?:directly )?to me|"
        r"being paid|accept (?:money|payments)"
    ) and not (missing or pending or declined or failed):
        add("receiving_money", 84 if not bank else 73)

    # Currency exchange as a service, a rate or a charge.
    if exchange and fee and not (card_payment or cash or topup or transfer):
        add("exchange_charge", 101)
    if exchange and h(
        r"in (?:the |my )?app|through (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"using (?:the |my )?app|within (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"which menu|where in (?:the |my )?app|"
        r"how (?:do|can|to) (?:i |we )?(?:exchange|convert)|"
        r"exchange (?:money|currenc(?:y|ies))|"
        r"convert (?:money|currenc(?:y|ies))|"
        r"currency balance into another"
    ) and not (fee or rate or card_payment or cash):
        add("exchange_via_app", 92)
    if rate and not (card_payment or cash):
        add("exchange_rate", 93)
    if exchange and h(
        r"rate|how much (?:will|do) i get|"
        r"what is (?:the|your) conversion"
    ) and not (card_payment or cash or fee):
        add("exchange_rate", 86)

    if scores:
        best = max(scores.values())
        tied = {label for label, strength in scores.items() if strength == best}
        if len(tied) == 1:
            return {"answer": next(iter(tied))}
        # Explicit resolution of equally supported, competing interpretations.
        tie_order = (
            "card_swallowed", "transaction_charged_twice",
            "wrong_amount_of_cash_received",
            "verify_source_of_funds", "compromised_card",
            "cash_withdrawal_not_recognised",
            "direct_debit_payment_not_recognised",
            "card_payment_not_recognised",
            "refund_not_showing_up",
            "balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit",
            "balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer",
            "transfer_not_received_by_recipient",
            "contactless_not_working", "virtual_card_not_working",
            "card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate",
            "wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal",
            "top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge", "top_up_by_card_charge",
            "cash_withdrawal_charge", "transfer_fee_charged",
            "card_payment_fee_charged", "extra_charge_on_statement",
            "lost_or_stolen_phone", "lost_or_stolen_card",
            "pin_blocked", "passcode_forgotten",
            "declined_cash_withdrawal", "declined_transfer",
            "declined_card_payment", "failed_transfer", "top_up_failed",
            "pending_cash_withdrawal", "pending_transfer",
            "pending_top_up", "pending_card_payment",
            "top_up_reverted", "reverted_card_payment",
            "card_arrival", "card_delivery_estimate",
            "card_linking", "change_pin", "activate_my_card",
            "unable_to_verify_identity", "why_verify_identity",
            "verify_top_up", "verify_my_identity",
            "disposable_card_limits", "get_disposable_virtual_card",
            "getting_spare_card", "getting_virtual_card",
            "order_physical_card", "get_physical_card",
            "automatic_top_up", "top_up_limits", "top_up_by_cash_or_cheque",
            "supported_cards_and_currencies", "fiat_currency_support",
            "country_support", "card_acceptance", "card_not_working",
            "transfer_into_account", "receiving_money", "transfer_timing",
            "topping_up_by_card", "request_refund", "exchange_charge",
            "exchange_via_app", "exchange_rate", "atm_support",
            "apple_pay_or_google_pay", "visa_or_mastercard",
            "age_limit", "terminate_account", "edit_personal_details",
            "card_about_to_expire", "cancel_transfer",
            "beneficiary_not_allowed",
        )
        for label in tie_order:
            if label in tied:
                return {"answer": label}

    if refund:
        return {"answer": "request_refund"}
    if rate or exchange:
        return {"answer": "exchange_rate"}
    if cash:
        return {"answer": "atm_support"}
    if transfer:
        return {"answer": "transfer_into_account" if incoming else "transfer_timing"}
    if topup:
        return {"answer": "topping_up_by_card"}
    if virtual:
        return {"answer": "getting_virtual_card"}
    if card:
        return {"answer": "card_not_working"}
    return {"answer": "receiving_money"}

import re
import unicodedata


def _normalize(value):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(value or ""))
    text = "".join(ch for ch in text if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    text = text.lower().replace("’", "'")
    text = re.sub(r"\bcan't\b", "can not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bwon't\b", "will not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'s\b", r"\1 is", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'ve\b", r"\1 have", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'m\b", r"\1 am", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'d\b", r"\1 would", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b([a-z]+)'ll\b", r"\1 will", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\btop[\s-]?up\b", "top up", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bmaster[\s-]?card\b", "mastercard", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bgoogle[\s-]?pay\b", "google pay", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bapple[\s-]?pay\b", "apple pay", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text)
    return " ".join(text.split())


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    scores = {}

    def h(pattern):
        return re.search(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + pattern + r")(?!\w)", text) is not None

    def near(first, second, distance=90):
        a = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + first + r")(?!\w)", text))
        b = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:" + second + r")(?!\w)", text))
        return any(
            max(x.start() - y.end(), y.start() - x.end(), 0) <= distance
            for x in a for y in b
        )

    def put(label, strength):
        scores[label] = max(scores.get(label, 0), strength)

    card = h(r"cards?|plastic")
    virtual = h(r"virtual|digital card|online card|e card|electronic card")
    disposable = h(r"disposable|single use|one time use|one use")
    physical = h(r"physical|plastic|tangible|real card")
    atm = h(
        r"atms?|cash ?machines?|cashpoints?|cash withdrawals?|"
        r"withdraw(?:ing|n|al|als)?|take out cash|taking out cash|"
        r"get cash out"
    )
    deposit_cash = h(
        r"cash deposit|deposit(?:ed|ing)? cash|cheques?|checks?|"
        r"cash into (?:my|the) account|pay in cash|paid in cash"
    )
    topup = h(
        r"top up|topping up|add(?:ing|ed)? (?:money|funds|cash|credit)|"
        r"load(?:ing|ed)? (?:money|funds|cash|my card|the card)|"
        r"recharg(?:e|ed|ing)|fund(?:ing)? (?:my|the) account"
    )
    transfer = h(
        r"transfers?|transferr(?:ed|ing)|bank wire|wire payment|"
        r"remittance|remit|iban|swift|send(?:ing|s|t)? money|"
        r"money sent|pay(?:ing)? (?:a |my |the )?beneficiar(?:y|ies)"
    )
    direct_debit = h(r"direct debit|standing order|recurring bank debit")
    purchase = h(
        r"purchas(?:e|ed|ing)|merchant|retailer|shop|store|checkout|"
        r"point of sale|pos terminal|paid (?:at|in|for|with)|"
        r"buy(?:ing|ought)?|card payment|card transaction"
    )
    payment = h(r"payments?|paid|paying|purchases?|transactions?|charges?")
    card_payment = (
        h(r"card payment|card transaction|debit card payment|credit card payment")
        or (card and (purchase or near(r"cards?", r"payments?|paid|charges?|transactions?")))
        or (purchase and not (topup or transfer or atm or direct_debit))
        or (payment and not (transfer or topup or atm or direct_debit or deposit_cash))
    )
    fee = h(
        r"fees?|surcharges?|commission|extra charges?|additional charges?|"
        r"charged (?:me )?(?:for|a fee)|charges? for|cost(?:s)? (?:to|of)|"
        r"payment charges?|withdrawal charges?|transfer charges?"
    )
    rate = h(
        r"exchange rates?|conversion rates?|fx rates?|forex rates?|"
        r"currency rates?|rate of exchange|wrong rate|bad rate"
    )
    exchange = h(
        r"exchang(?:e|ing|ed)|convert(?:ing|ed|s)?|conversion|"
        r"swap(?:ping)? (?:currenc(?:y|ies)|money)|fx|forex"
    )
    unrecognized = h(
        r"do not recogni[sz]e|not recogni[sz]e|unrecogni[sz]ed|"
        r"not mine|not my (?:payment|transaction|withdrawal|charge)|"
        r"never (?:made|did|authori[sz]ed|withdrew|bought|paid)|"
        r"did not (?:make|authori[sz]e|withdraw|pay|buy)|"
        r"unauthori[sz]ed|unknown (?:payment|transaction|charge|withdrawal)|"
        r"fraudulent (?:payment|transaction|charge|withdrawal)|"
        r"who (?:made|authori[sz]ed) (?:this|the)"
    )
    declined = h(
        r"declin(?:e|ed|ing)|reject(?:ed|ion|ing)?|refus(?:ed|al)|"
        r"denied|not accepted|would not accept|not allowed|"
        r"would not let me (?:pay|withdraw|transfer|send)"
    )
    failed = h(
        r"fail(?:ed|ing|ure|s)?|unsuccessful|did not go through|"
        r"has not gone through|could not go through|"
        r"not going through|would not go through|"
        r"did not work|does not work|not working|cannot (?:send|transfer|top up)"
    )
    pending = h(
        r"pending|processing|in progress|on hold|stuck|"
        r"still waiting|not (?:yet )?(?:completed|complete|finali[sz]ed)|"
        r"taking (?:so )?long to (?:process|complete|clear)"
    )
    reversed_ = h(
        r"revert(?:ed|ing)?|revers(?:ed|al|ing)|"
        r"cancelled (?:automatically|by itself)|bounced back|"
        r"sent back|returned (?:to my|to the|back to)|"
        r"money (?:was|has been) (?:taken back|returned)"
    )
    missing = h(
        r"not (?:showing|appearing|visible|there|arrived|received|credited)|"
        r"has not (?:shown|appeared|arrived|come|been credited|updated)|"
        r"did not (?:show|appear|arrive|receive|get credited)|"
        r"still (?:not|missing)|missing|where is|where did .* go|"
        r"no sign of|not in (?:my|the) account|not reflected"
    )
    how = h(
        r"how (?:do|can|could|would|should|to)|where (?:can|do|to)|"
        r"want to|would like to|need to|trying to"
    )
    time = h(
        r"how long|when (?:will|does|do|should|can)|"
        r"how (?:fast|soon|quickly)|time(?:frame|scale)?|"
        r"how many (?:days|hours|weeks)|estimated|estimate|eta|"
        r"delivery date|arrival date"
    )
    incoming = h(
        r"into (?:my|the|our) account|to (?:my|the|our) account|"
        r"to me|someone (?:sent|transferred|paid)|"
        r"receive(?:d|ing)? (?:money|funds|a payment|a transfer)|"
        r"incoming|inbound|bank deposit|pay (?:me|into)"
    )
    recipient = h(
        r"recipient|beneficiar(?:y|ies)|person i sent|"
        r"person i (?:paid|transferred)|they (?:have not|did not) receive|"
        r"has not received (?:my|the) (?:money|transfer|payment)|"
        r"not (?:reached|arrived at) (?:the|their|his|her) account|"
        r"other account|to (?:his|her|their) account"
    )

    # Security, access, identity, and account details.
    phone = h(r"phone|mobile|handset|smartphone|device")
    loss = h(r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing")
    if phone and loss and near(r"phone|mobile|handset|smartphone|device",
                               r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"):
        put("lost_or_stolen_phone", 30)
    if card and loss and near(r"cards?|plastic",
                              r"lost|stolen|robbed|misplaced|cannot find|can not find|missing"):
        put("lost_or_stolen_card", 29)
    if card and h(
        r"compromised|cloned|skimmed|card details (?:stolen|leaked|exposed)|"
        r"card number (?:stolen|leaked|exposed)|"
        r"someone (?:has|knows) my card (?:details|number)|"
        r"card (?:security|information) (?:breach|leak)"
    ):
        put("compromised_card", 31)
    if h(r"passcode|pass code|app pin|login pin|login code|access code") and h(
        r"forgot|forgotten|cannot remember|can not remember|do not remember|"
        r"lost|reset|recover"
    ):
        put("passcode_forgotten", 29)
    if h(r"\bpin\b|pin number") and h(
        r"blocked|locked|too many (?:attempts|tries)|"
        r"wrong pin (?:too many|several|multiple) times|unblock|unlock"
    ):
        put("pin_blocked", 29)
    if h(r"\bpin\b|pin number") and h(
        r"change|reset|update|new pin|choose|set|forgot|remember"
    ):
        put("change_pin", 23 if h(r"blocked|locked|unblock") else 28)
    if h(
        r"personal details|personal information|profile|address|"
        r"phone number|email address|legal name|surname|date of birth"
    ) and h(r"change|edit|update|correct|modify|wrong|new|move|moved"):
        put("edit_personal_details", 29)
    if h(r"account") and h(
        r"close|terminate|delete|deactivate|shut down|cancel my account|"
        r"stop using|permanently remove"
    ):
        put("terminate_account", 30)
    if h(r"age|years old|birthday|minor|underage|under 18|over 18|adult") and h(
        r"minimum|limit|requirement|eligible|old enough|open|account|card|join|sign up"
    ):
        put("age_limit", 30)

    identity = h(
        r"identit(?:y|ies)|id document|passport|driver(?:s)? licen[cs]e|"
        r"selfie|know your customer|kyc|verification|verify (?:me|myself)"
    )
    verify = h(r"verif(?:y|ication|ied)|confirm|prove|validate|identification")
    if h(r"source of funds|source of wealth|proof of funds|origin of (?:my |the )?funds|"
         r"where (?:my |the )?money (?:came|comes) from"):
        put("verify_source_of_funds", 33)
    if identity and verify and h(
        r"cannot|can not|unable|trouble|problem|keeps failing|"
        r"rejected|not accepted|does not work|unsuccessful|stuck|"
        r"documents? (?:rejected|failed)|verification failed"
    ):
        put("unable_to_verify_identity", 32)
    if identity and verify and h(
        r"why|reason|necessary|have to|need to|required|requirement|"
        r"what for|purpose"
    ):
        put("why_verify_identity", 30)
    if identity and (verify or h(r"submit|upload|documents?")):
        put("verify_my_identity", 23)
    if topup and verify and not identity:
        put("verify_top_up", 31)
    if h(r"top up verification|verify (?:a |my |the )?top up|"
         r"verify (?:the |my )?(?:card|payment) (?:for|to) (?:a |my )?top up"):
        put("verify_top_up", 32)

    # Card provisioning, delivery, and operation.
    if h(r"apple pay|google pay|apple wallet|google wallet|gpay|"
         r"add (?:my |the )?card to (?:my )?(?:iphone|wallet)|"
         r"pay with (?:my )?(?:iphone|android|phone)"):
        put("apple_pay_or_google_pay", 33)
    if h(r"visa|mastercard|master card|card network") and h(
        r"card|visa|mastercard|network|which|do you|is it"
    ):
        put("visa_or_mastercard", 29)
    if card and h(
        r"activat(?:e|ion|ed|ing)|enable (?:my |the )?card|"
        r"start using (?:my |the )?(?:new )?card"
    ):
        put("activate_my_card", 31)
    if card and h(
        r"expir(?:e|es|ed|ing|y|ation)|valid until|valid thru|"
        r"expiring soon|out of date|renew(?:al|ed)?"
    ):
        put("card_about_to_expire", 31)
    if card and h(
        r"link(?:ed|ing)?|connect(?:ed|ing)?|"
        r"attach(?:ed|ing)?|pair(?:ed|ing)?"
    ) and h(r"account|app|card"):
        put("card_linking", 29)
    if card and h(
        r"swallowed|eaten|kept my card|retained my card|"
        r"atm (?:took|kept|ate)|card (?:stuck|trapped) in (?:an? )?(?:atm|machine)"
    ):
        put("card_swallowed", 34)
    if card and h(
        r"spare|backup|replacement|replace my card|replace the card|"
        r"another card|second card|extra card|new card because"
    ) and h(r"get|order|request|need|want|send|replace|obtain|how"):
        put("getting_spare_card", 29)
    if disposable and card and h(
        r"limit|maximum|max|how many|number of|"
        r"how often|frequency|per day|per month|restriction"
    ):
        put("disposable_card_limits", 33)
    if disposable and (card or virtual) and h(
        r"get|create|generate|make|obtain|request|order|"
        r"how|where|want|need|available"
    ):
        put("get_disposable_virtual_card", 31)
    if virtual and card and h(
        r"not working|does not work|did not work|cannot use|can not use|"
        r"declined|rejected|failed|problem|issue|unable to (?:use|pay)|"
        r"not accepted"
    ):
        put("virtual_card_not_working", 32)
    if virtual and (card or h(r"create|generate")) and h(
        r"get|create|generate|obtain|order|request|"
        r"how|where|want|need|available|apply"
    ):
        put("getting_virtual_card", 25 if disposable else 30)
    if physical and card and h(
        r"order|request|apply for|place an order"
    ) and not h(r"replacement|replace|spare|backup"):
        put("order_physical_card", 30)
    if physical and card and h(
        r"get|obtain|receive|how|where|want|need|available|"
        r"can i have|send me"
    ) and not h(r"replacement|replace|spare|backup"):
        put("get_physical_card", 25 if h(r"order|request") else 29)

    delivery = card and h(
        r"deliver(?:y|ed|ing)?|arriv(?:e|ed|al|ing)|"
        r"ship(?:ped|ping|ment)?|post(?:ed|age)?|mail(?:ed|ing)?|"
        r"dispatch(?:ed)?|come in the post|on its way"
    )
    if delivery and time:
        put("card_delivery_estimate", 31)
    if delivery and h(
        r"not (?:yet )?(?:arrived|delivered|received|come)|"
        r"has not (?:arrived|come|been delivered)|"
        r"still waiting|where is|track|lost in (?:the )?post|"
        r"late|overdue|never (?:arrived|came)|missing"
    ):
        put("card_arrival", 33)
    if delivery and not time:
        put("card_arrival", 22)
    if card and h(
        r"where (?:can|will) (?:i|my card) (?:use|pay|work)|"
        r"accept(?:ed|ance)?|use (?:my |the )?card (?:in|at|abroad)|"
        r"which (?:shops|stores|merchants|places)|"
        r"can (?:i |we )?(?:pay|purchase|buy) (?:with|using) (?:my |the )?card"
    ) and not (declined or failed):
        put("card_acceptance", 28)
    if h(r"contactless|tap to pay|tap and pay|nfc|paywave|paypass|"
         r"tap (?:my |the )?card") and (
        failed or declined or h(r"not working|cannot|can not|unable|problem|issue")
    ):
        put("contactless_not_working", 33)
    if card and h(
        r"not working|does not work|did not work|cannot use|can not use|"
        r"unable to use|card is broken|card stopped working|"
        r"problem with (?:my |the )?card|card does not function|"
        r"card is faulty"
    ):
        put("card_not_working", 23 if virtual or h(r"contactless") else 28)

    # Supported facilities, locations, and currencies.
    if h(r"atm|cash machine|cashpoint") and h(
        r"which|where|support|compatible|use|work|available|network|"
        r"find|accept|withdraw"
    ) and not (failed or declined or fee or pending or unrecognized):
        put("atm_support", 28)
    if h(
        r"countries|country|region|territor(?:y|ies)|"
        r"nationalit(?:y|ies)|resident|residency"
    ) and h(
        r"support|available|eligible|open an account|sign up|"
        r"operate|service|join|live in|based in|which|what|where"
    ) and not (card and h(r"use|accepted|work|pay")):
        put("country_support", 29)
    if h(r"currenc(?:y|ies)|fiat|dollars?|euros?|pounds?|gbp|usd|eur") and h(
        r"support|available|which|what|hold|account|"
        r"add|use|accepted|list"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or fee):
        put("fiat_currency_support", 27)
    if card and h(r"currenc(?:y|ies)|fiat|visa|mastercard") and h(
        r"support|accepted|eligible|which|what|"
        r"top up|use to add|can i use"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or fee):
        put("supported_cards_and_currencies", 28)

    # Unauthorised transactions, discrepancies, and card payments.
    if direct_debit and unrecognized:
        put("direct_debit_payment_not_recognised", 36)
    if atm and unrecognized:
        put("cash_withdrawal_not_recognised", 35)
    if card_payment and unrecognized and not direct_debit and not atm:
        put("card_payment_not_recognised", 34)
    if unrecognized and h(r"payment|purchase|transaction|charge") and not (
        atm or direct_debit or transfer or topup
    ):
        put("card_payment_not_recognised", 31)
    if h(
        r"charged twice|charged (?:me )?(?:two|2) times|"
        r"double charged|duplicate (?:charge|payment|transaction|debit)|"
        r"same (?:payment|transaction|charge) twice|"
        r"debited twice|paid twice|two identical (?:charges|payments)"
    ):
        put("transaction_charged_twice", 37)
    if h(r"statement|transaction history|list of transactions") and h(
        r"extra charge|additional charge|unexpected charge|"
        r"more than|higher than|different amount|overcharged|"
        r"charged more|extra transaction"
    ):
        put("extra_charge_on_statement", 32)
    if card_payment and h(
        r"extra charge|additional charge|overcharged|"
        r"charged more|different amount|higher amount"
    ) and not (rate or exchange or unrecognized):

    if card_payment and declined:

    # Refunds: requesting one differs from waiting for an already-issued refund.

        put("request_refund", 28)

    funding_card = topup and h(

        r"using (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"
        r"from (?:my |a |the )?(?:debit|credit|bank|another)? ?card|"

    )

    ):

    ) and not (missing or pending or declined or failed):

    if exchange and fee and not (card_payment or atm or topup or transfer):

        put("exchange_rate", 32)
    if exchange and h(r"rate|how much (?:will|do) i get|"
                      r"what is (?:the|your) conversion") and not (
        card_payment or atm or fee
    ):
        put("exchange_rate", 29)

    # Prefer a clearly identified problem over a general question about a method.
    if scores:
        best = max(scores.values())
        contenders = [label for label, value in scores.items() if value == best]
        if len(contenders) == 1:
            return {"answer": contenders[0]}
        tie_preferences = (
            "wrong_amount_of_cash_received",
            "transaction_charged_twice",
            "refund_not_showing_up",
            "balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit",
            "balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer",
            "transfer_not_received_by_recipient",
            "virtual_card_not_working",

            "declined_cash_withdrawal",
            "declined_card_payment",
            "declined_transfer",
            "failed_transfer",
            "top_up_failed",
            "pending_cash_withdrawal",
            "pending_card_payment",
            "pending_transfer",
            "pending_top_up",
            "card_arrival",
            "card_delivery_estimate",
        )
        for label in tie_preferences:
            if label in contenders:
                return {"answer": label}
        return {"answer": sorted(contenders)[0]}

    # Weak evidence is useful only when no specific intent was established.
    if h(r"refund|money back"):
        return {"answer": "request_refund"}
    if h(r"exchange|conversion|currency rate"):
        return {"answer": "exchange_rate"}
    if atm:
        return {"answer": "atm_support"}
    if transfer:
        return {"answer": "transfer_into_account" if incoming else "transfer_timing"}
    if topup:
        return {"answer": "topping_up_by_card"}
    if virtual:
        return {"answer": "getting_virtual_card"}
    if card:
        return {"answer": "card_not_working"}
    return {"answer": "receiving_money"}

import re

def _extract_text(state):
    if isinstance(state, str):
        return state
    if isinstance(state, dict):
        preferred = (
            "text", "sentence", "review", "review_text", "content",
            "comment", "utterance", "input", "message", "description",
            "state",
        )
        for key in preferred:
            if key in state:
                text = _extract_text(state[key])
                if text:
                    return text
        parts = [_extract_text(value) for value in state.values()]
        return " ".join(part for part in parts if part)
    if isinstance(state, (list, tuple)):
        return " ".join(filter(None, (_extract_text(item) for item in state)))
    return ""

_SORTED_PHRASES = sorted(
    ((tuple(phrase.split()), score) for phrase, score in _PHRASES.items()),
    key=lambda item: len(item[0]),
    reverse=True,
)

_BREAKS = {".", "!", "?", ";", ":", ","}
_CONTRAST = {"but", "however", "yet", "nevertheless", "nonetheless"}
_CONCESSION = {"although", "though", "despite", "whereas", "while"}
_NEGATORS = {
    "not", "never", "no", "nothing", "neither", "nor",
    "without", "hardly", "scarcely", "barely",
}
_INTENSIFIERS = {
    "very", "really", "extremely", "incredibly", "truly",
    "utterly", "absolutely", "particularly", "remarkably",
    "highly", "deeply", "thoroughly", "so", "quite",
}
_DOWNTONERS = {"somewhat", "slightly", "mildly", "fairly"}


def _normalize(text):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text.casefold())
    text = "".join(char for char in text if not unicodedata.combining(char))
    text = text.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    replacements = (
        (r"\bwon't\b", "will not"),
        (r"\bcan't\b", "can not"),
        (r"\bcannot\b", "can not"),
        (r"\bain't\b", "is not"),
        (r"\b(\w+)n't\b", r"\1 not"),
        (r"\b(\w+)'re\b", r"\1 are"),
        (r"\b(\w+)'ve\b", r"\1 have"),
        (r"\b(\w+)'ll\b", r"\1 will"),
        (r"\b(\w+)'d\b", r"\1 would"),
        (r"\bit's\b", "it is"),
        (r"\bthat's\b", "that is"),
        (r"\bthere's\b", "there is"),
    )
    for pattern, replacement in replacements:
        text = re.sub(pattern, replacement, text)
    text = re.sub(r"(\w)-(\w)", r"\1 \2", text)
    return re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?|[.!?;:,]", text)


def _word_score(word):
    if word in _LEXICON:
        return _LEXICON[word]
    if word.endswith("ly") and len(word) > 5:
        root = word[:-2]
        if root in _LEXICON:
            return _LEXICON[root] * 0.7
    if word.endswith("ies") and word[:-3] + "y" in _LEXICON:
        return _LEXICON[word[:-3] + "y"]
    if word.endswith("es") and word[:-2] in _LEXICON:
        return _LEXICON[word[:-2]]
    if word.endswith("s") and word[:-1] in _LEXICON:
        return _LEXICON[word[:-1]]
    if word.endswith("ed") and word[:-2] in _LEXICON:
        return _LEXICON[word[:-2]]
    if word.endswith("ing") and word[:-3] in _LEXICON:
        return _LEXICON[word[:-3]]
    return 0


def _is_negated(tokens, start, ignored):
    count = 0
    checked = 0
    for pos in range(start - 1, max(-1, start - 9), -1):
        word = tokens[pos]
        if word in _BREAKS or word in _CONTRAST or word in _CONCESSION:
            break
        if word in _NEGATORS and pos not in ignored:
            count += 1
        if word == "from" and pos > 0 and tokens[pos - 1] == "far":
            count += 1
        if word in {"fail", "fails", "failed", "failing", "lack", "lacks", "lacking"}:
            count += 1
        checked += 1
        if checked >= 7:
            break
    return count % 2 == 1


def _modifier(tokens, start):
    factor = 1.0
    for word in tokens[max(0, start - 3):start]:
        if word in _INTENSIFIERS:
            factor *= 1.2
        elif word in _DOWNTONERS:
            factor *= 0.75
    return min(factor, 1.6)


def _contrast_weights(tokens):
    weights = [1.0] * len(tokens)
    for i, word in enumerate(tokens):
        if word in _CONTRAST:
            before = tokens[max(0, i - 3):i]
            if word == "but" and (
                "anything" in before
                or "nothing" in before
                or ("only" in before and "not" in before)
                or ("just" in before and "not" in before)
            ):
                continue
            for j in range(i):
                weights[j] *= 0.55
            for j in range(i + 1, len(tokens)):
                weights[j] *= 1.8
        elif word in _CONCESSION:
            if i <= 3:
                for j in range(i + 1):
                    weights[j] *= 0.7
                for j in range(i + 1, len(tokens)):
                    weights[j] *= 1.35
            else:
                for j in range(i):
                    weights[j] *= 1.25
                for j in range(i + 1, len(tokens)):
                    weights[j] *= 0.7
    return weights


def _sentiment(text):
    tokens = _normalize(text)
    if not tokens:
        return "positive"

    ignored_negators = set()
    for i, word in enumerate(tokens[:-1]):
        if word == "not" and tokens[i + 1] in {"only", "just"}:
            ignored_negators.add(i)

    weights = _contrast_weights(tokens)
    used = set()
    total = 0.0

    for phrase, score in _SORTED_PHRASES:
        length = len(phrase)
        for i in range(len(tokens) - length + 1):
            if any(pos in used for pos in range(i, i + length)):
                continue
            if tuple(tokens[i:i + length]) != phrase:
                continue
            value = score
            if value and _is_negated(tokens, i, ignored_negators):
                value = -value * 0.85
            total += value * weights[i]
            used.update(range(i, i + length))

    for i, word in enumerate(tokens):
        if i in used:
            continue
        value = _word_score(word)
        if not value:
            continue
        if _is_negated(tokens, i, ignored_negators):
            value = -value * 0.85
        total += value * _modifier(tokens, i) * weights[i]

    return "positive" if total >= 0 else "negative"


def predict(state) -> dict:
    return {"answer": _sentiment(_extract_text(state))}

def _normalize(state):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(state)).lower()
    text = text.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    text = text.replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
    text = re.sub(r"\bcan't\b", "can not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bwon't\b", "will not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bain't\b", "is not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'re\b", r"\1 are", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'ve\b", r"\1 have", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'ll\b", r"\1 will", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'d\b", r"\1 would", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'s\b", r"\1 is", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\banything but\b", "not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bnothing but\b", "just", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bno doubt\b", "certainly", text)
    return text


def _word_value(word):
    if word in POSITIVE:
        return POSITIVE[word]
    if word in NEGATIVE:
        return NEGATIVE[word]
    if word == "liking":
        return 1.5
    if word in {"disliking", "unfunny", "uninteresting", "unoriginal", "unpleasant"}:
        return -2.2
    if word in {"underrated", "underrate"}:
        return 1.8
    if word in {"disappointing", "disappointment", "disappointments"}:
        return -2.5
    if word in {"entertaining", "entertained", "entertainment"}:
        return 2.3
    if word in {"impressing", "impressive"}:
        return 2.2
    if word in {"unimpressive", "unimpressed"}:
        return -2.1
    if word in {"lacking", "lack", "lacks", "lacked"}:
        return -1.2
    if word in {"fails", "failed", "failing", "failure"}:
        return -2.4
    if word in {"succeeds", "succeeded", "succeeding", "success"}:
        return 1.8
    for suffix, replacements in (
        ("ingly", ("", "e")),
        ("edly", ("", "e")),
        ("ing", ("", "e")),
        ("ed", ("", "e")),
        ("ies", ("y",)),
        ("es", ("",)),
        ("s", ("",)),
    ):
        if word.endswith(suffix) and len(word) > len(suffix) + 2:
            base = word[:-len(suffix)]
            for ending in replacements:
                candidate = base + ending
                if candidate in POSITIVE:
                    return POSITIVE[candidate]
                if candidate in NEGATIVE:
                    return NEGATIVE[candidate]
    return 0.0


def _sentiment_clause(clause):
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"[a-z]+", clause))
    words = [match.group() for match in matches]
    masked = set()
    score = 0.0
    evidence = 0

    for pattern, value in COMPILED_PHRASES:
        for found in pattern.finditer(clause):
            indices = [
                i for i, match in enumerate(matches)
                if match.start() < found.end() and match.end() > found.start()
            ]
            if not indices or any(i in masked for i in indices):
                continue
            masked.update(indices)
            score += value
            if value:
                evidence += 1

    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if i in masked:
            continue
        value = _word_value(word)
        if not value:
            continue

        # "Like" often introduces a comparison rather than expressing approval.
        if word == "like" and (
            i == 0 or words[i - 1] in
            {"looks", "look", "seems", "seem", "sounds", "sound", "films",
             "movies", "something", "anything", "people", "things"}
        ):
            continue

        left = words[max(0, i - 8):i]
        if word in {"love", "loves"} and i + 1 < len(words) and words[i + 1] in {
            "story", "triangle", "interest", "scene"
        }:
            continue

        negations = 0
        for j in range(max(0, i - 7), i):
            if j in masked:
                continue
            if words[j] in NEGATORS:
                if words[j] == "not" and j + 1 < len(words) and words[j + 1] in {
                    "only", "just", "merely"
                }:
                    continue
                if words[j] in {"lack", "lacks", "lacked", "lacking"} and value < 0:
                    continue
                negations += 1

        if negations % 2:
            value = -value * (0.85 if value > 0 else 0.65)

        if any(word_before in INTENSIFIERS for word_before in left[-2:]):
            value *= 1.22
        elif any(word_before in DIMINISHERS for word_before in left[-2:]):
            value *= 0.7

        # Hoped-for quality is not an assertion that the film has that quality.
        if value > 0 and re.search(
            r"\b(?:wish|wished|hoped|hoping|wanted)\b", clause[:matches[i].start()]
        ):
            if re.search(
                r"\b(?:wish(?:ed)?|hop(?:ed|ing)|wanted)\b.{0,65}"
                r"\b(?:was|were|would|could|had|to be)\b",
                clause[:matches[i].start()]
            ):
                value *= -0.55

        if value > 0 and re.search(
            r"\b(?:could|would|should) have been\b",
            clause[max(0, matches[i].start() - 35):matches[i].start()]
        ):
            value *= -0.65

        score += value
        evidence += 1

    return score, evidence


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    parts = re.split(
        r"\b(but|however|yet|though|although|nevertheless|nonetheless|whereas)\b"
        r"|[.!?;]+",
        text
    )

    clauses = []
    next_contrast = False
    for part in parts:
        if not part:
            continue
        if part in CONTRAST:
            next_contrast = True
            continue
        if part.strip():
            clauses.append((part, next_contrast))
            next_contrast = False

    if not clauses:
        return {"answer": "positive"}

    results = [_sentiment_clause(clause) for clause, _ in clauses]
    last_contrast = max(
        (i for i, (_, contrast) in enumerate(clauses) if contrast and results[i][1]),
        default=-1
    )

    total = 0.0
    for i, (score, _) in enumerate(results):
        if last_contrast >= 0:
            weight = 0.55 if i < last_contrast else 1.55
        else:
            weight = 1.0
        total += score * weight

    if total == 0:
        return {"answer": "positive"}
    return {"answer": "positive" if total > 0 else "negative"}

def _normalize(state):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(state)).lower()
    text = text.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    text = text.replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
    text = re.sub(r"\bcan't\b", "can not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bwon't\b", "will not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bain't\b", "is not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'re\b", r"\1 are", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'ve\b", r"\1 have", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'ll\b", r"\1 will", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'d\b", r"\1 would", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)'s\b", r"\1 is", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\banything but\b", "not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bnothing but\b", "just", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bno doubt\b", "certainly", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bheavy[\s-]+handed\b", "heavyhanded", text)
    return text


def _word_value(word):
    if word in POS:
        return POS[word]
    if word in NEG:
        return NEG[word]

    special = {
        "liking": 1.6, "disliking": -2.4,
        "unfunny": -2.6, "uninteresting": -2.4,
        "unoriginal": -2.1, "unpleasant": -2.1,
        "underrated": 1.9, "overrated": -2.0,
        "disappointment": -2.5, "disappointments": -2.5,
        "entertainment": 1.5, "unimpressed": -2.0,
        "unimpressive": -2.0, "lack": -1.3, "lacks": -1.3,
        "lacked": -1.3, "lacking": -1.3,
        "success": 1.7, "impressing": 1.8,
        "careless": -1.8, "senseless": -2.0,
        "overlong": -2.1, "overstuffed": -2.1,
        "underwritten": -2.3, "overwritten": -2.0,
    }
    if word in special:
        return special[word]

    for suffix, endings in (
        ("ingly", ("", "e")), ("edly", ("", "e")),
        ("ing", ("", "e")), ("ed", ("", "e")),
        ("ies", ("y",)), ("es", ("",)), ("s", ("",)),
    ):
        if word.endswith(suffix) and len(word) > len(suffix) + 2:
            stem = word[:-len(suffix)]
            for ending in endings:
                base = stem + ending
                if base in POS:
                    return POS[base]
                if base in NEG:
                    return NEG[base]
    return 0.0


def _hypothetical(prefix):
    return bool(re.search(
        r"\b(?:wish(?:ed)?|hop(?:ed|ing)|wanted|expected|promis(?:ed|es)|"
        r"aims?|attempts?|attempted|tries|tried|supposed|meant)\b"
        r"(?:\W+\w+){0,7}\W*$",
        prefix
    ))


def _score_clause(clause):
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"[a-z]+", clause))
    words = [match.group() for match in matches]
    masked = set()
    contributions = []

    # Longer expressions are tried first so a broad idiom cannot consume
    # part of a more informative, narrower one.
    candidates = []
    for pattern, score in RULES:
        for found in pattern.finditer(clause):
            candidates.append((found.start(), found.end(), score))
    candidates.sort(key=lambda item: (-(item[1] - item[0]), item[0]))

    for start, end, value in candidates:
        indices = [
            i for i, match in enumerate(matches)
            if match.start() < end and match.end() > start
        ]
        if not indices or any(i in masked for i in indices):
            continue
        masked.update(indices)
        contributions.append(value)

    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if i in masked:
            continue
        value = _word_value(word)
        if not value:
            continue

        before = words[max(0, i - 7):i]
        after = words[i + 1:i + 5]
        prefix = clause[:matches[i].start()]
        following = clause[matches[i].end():]

        if word == "like" and (
            i == 0 or words[i - 1] in {
                "looks", "look", "seems", "seem", "sounds", "sound",
                "something", "anything", "movies", "films", "people",
                "characters", "feels", "feel", "more", "less",
            }
        ):
            continue
        if word in {"love", "loves"} and after and after[0] in {
            "story", "triangle", "interest", "scene",
        }:
            continue
        if word in {"better", "best"} and after and after[0] in {
            "part", "thing", "than", "off",
        }:
            if after[0] == "off":
                value = -1.8

        # An adjective describing an imagined or advertised film is not
        # necessarily an assessment of the film that was released.
        if _hypothetical(prefix[-100:]):
            if re.search(r"\b(?:trailers?|promos?|marketing)\b", prefix[-90:]):
                continue
            if re.search(r"\b(?:could|would|should) have (?:seemed|been|felt)\b", prefix[-55:]):
                continue
            if re.search(r"\b(?:supposedly|allegedly)\s*$", prefix):
                continue
            if re.search(r"\b(?:tries|tried|attempts|attempted|aims|meant) to (?:be|feel)\s*$", prefix):
                if value > 0:
                    value = -0.8

        if re.search(r"\b(?:could|would|should) have (?:been|felt)\s*$", prefix[-50:]):
            if value > 0:
                value = -value * 0.7
            else:
                value *= 0.3

        if word in {"awkward", "cruel", "evil", "dark", "sad"}:
            if after and after[0] in {
                "conversation", "character", "villain", "scene", "moment",
                "moments", "story",
            }:
                value *= 0.3

        # Limit negation to the current short phrase; do not negate every
        # sentiment word in a long sentence.
        negations = 0
        for j in range(max(0, i - 5), i):
            if j in masked or words[j] not in NEGATORS:
                continue
            intervening = words[j + 1:i]
            if any(w in {"but", "because", "although", "though", "while",
                         "however", "and", "than", "whereas"} for w in intervening):
                continue
            if words[j] == "not" and intervening[:1] in (["only"], ["just"], ["merely"]):
                continue
            negations += 1

        if negations % 2:
            value = -value * (0.9 if value > 0 else 0.72)

        if before[-2:] and any(w in INTENSIFIERS for w in before[-2:]):
            value *= 1.2
        elif any(w in DIMINISHERS for w in before[-2:]):
            value *= 0.7

        # "Only" and "a few" often delimit praise to a minor exception.
        if value > 0 and any(w in LIMITING_WORDS for w in before[-3:]):
            value *= 0.5
        if value > 0 and word in {"admired", "appreciated", "liked"}:
            if re.search(r"\b(?:more than|even as|despite)\b", following[:90]):
                value *= 0.75
        if value > 0 and re.search(
            r"\b(?:wish|wished|hoped|hoping|wanted)\b.{0,55}"
            r"\b(?:was|were|would|could|had|to be)\s*$",
            prefix[-95:]
        ):
            value *= -0.6

        if word in {"slow", "long"} and after and after[0] in {
            "burn", "take", "takes",
        }:
            value *= 0.2

        contributions.append(value)

    if not contributions:
        return 0.0, 0

    positive = sum(value for value in contributions if value > 0)
    negative = sum(value for value in contributions if value < 0)

    # In mixed reviews, praise restricted to a premise, trailer, production
    # detail, or stated intention should not eclipse criticism of the film.
    if positive and negative:
        if re.search(
            r"\b(?:sets?|visuals?|cinematography|lighting|soundtrack|score|"
            r"premise|concept|message|opening|cast|performances?)\b",
            clause
        ) and re.search(
            r"\b(?:story|plot|script|film|movie|ending|finale|characters?|"
            r"storytelling|scenes?)\b",
            clause
        ):
            positive *= 0.78
        if re.search(r"\b(?:only|just|a few|one|single)\b", clause):
            positive *= 0.75

    return positive + negative, len(contributions)


def _clauses(text):
    # A concessive opening describes an exception; the main clause following
    # it normally carries the reviewer's judgment.
    text = re.sub(
        r"\b(despite|in spite of|for all|although|even though)\b"
        r"([^,.;!?]{1,110}),",
        r"\1\2 but ",
        text
    )
    separators = re.compile(
        r"\b(even as|instead of|rather than|only to|but|however|yet|"
        r"nevertheless|nonetheless|whereas|then)\b|[.!?;]+"
    )

    result = []
    position = 0
    marker = ""
    for found in separators.finditer(text):
        part = text[position:found.start()].strip(" ,")
        if part:
            result.append((part, marker))
            marker = ""
        if found.group(1):
            marker = found.group(1)
        position = found.end()
    tail = text[position:].strip(" ,")
    if tail:
        result.append((tail, marker))
    return result


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    clauses = _clauses(text)
    if not clauses:
        return {"answer": "positive"}

    scores = [_score_clause(clause) for clause, _ in clauses]
    last_turn = max(
        (
            i for i, (_, marker) in enumerate(clauses)
            if marker in CONTRAST_WORDS and scores[i][1]
        ),
        default=-1
    )

    total = 0.0
    for i, (score, _) in enumerate(scores):
        if last_turn >= 0:
            weight = 0.58 if i < last_turn else 1.55
        else:
            weight = 1.0
        total += weight * score

    return {"answer": "negative" if total < 0 else "positive"}

def _normalize(state):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(state)).lower()
    text = text.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    text = text.replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
    text = re.sub(r"\bcan't\b", "can not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bwon't\b", "will not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bain't\b", "is not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)
    for ending, replacement in (
        ("'re", " are"), ("'ve", " have"), ("'ll", " will"),
        ("'d", " would"), ("'s", " is"),
    ):
        text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)" + ending + r"\b", r"\1" + replacement, text)
    text = re.sub(r"\banything but\b", "not", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bnothing but\b", "just", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bno doubt\b", "certainly", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bheavy[\s-]+handed\b", "heavyhanded", text)
    return text


def _word_value(word):
    if word in POS:
        return POS[word]
    if word in NEG:
        return NEG[word]

    special = {
        "liking": 1.6, "disliking": -2.4,
        "unfunny": -2.6, "uninteresting": -2.4,
        "unoriginal": -2.1, "unpleasant": -2.1,
        "underrated": 1.9, "disappointment": -2.5,
        "disappointments": -2.5, "disappointingly": -2.5,
        "entertainment": 1.5, "unimpressed": -2.0,
        "unimpressive": -2.0, "lack": -1.3, "lacks": -1.3,
        "lacked": -1.3, "lacking": -1.3,
        "success": 1.7, "impressing": 1.8,
        "careless": -1.8, "senseless": -2.0,
        "overlong": -2.1, "overstuffed": -2.1,
        "underwritten": -2.3, "overwritten": -2.0,
        "bored": -2.5, "forgettable": -2.0,
        "exhausted": -1.8, "tiresome": -2.2,
    }
    if word in special:
        return special[word]

    for suffix, endings in (
        ("ingly", ("", "e")), ("edly", ("", "e")),
        ("ing", ("", "e")), ("ed", ("", "e")),
        ("ies", ("y",)), ("es", ("",)), ("s", ("",)),
    ):
        if word.endswith(suffix) and len(word) > len(suffix) + 2:
            stem = word[:-len(suffix)]
            for ending in endings:
                base = stem + ending
                if base in POS:
                    return POS[base]
                if base in NEG:
                    return NEG[base]
    return 0.0


def _score_clause(clause):
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"[a-z]+", clause))
    words = [match.group() for match in matches]
    masked = set()
    contributions = []

    candidates = []
    for pattern, score in RULES:
        for found in pattern.finditer(clause):
            candidates.append((found.start(), found.end(), score))
    candidates.sort(key=lambda item: (-(item[1] - item[0]), item[0]))

    for start, end, value in candidates:
        indices = [
            i for i, match in enumerate(matches)
            if match.start() < end and match.end() > start
        ]
        if not indices or any(i in masked for i in indices):
            continue
        masked.update(indices)
        if value:
            contributions.append(value)

    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if i in masked:
            continue
        value = _word_value(word)
        if not value:
            continue

        before = words[max(0, i - 6):i]
        after = words[i + 1:i + 5]
        prefix = clause[:matches[i].start()]
        following = clause[matches[i].end():]

        if word == "like" and (
            i == 0 or words[i - 1] in {
                "looks", "look", "seems", "seem", "sounds", "sound",
                "something", "anything", "movies", "films", "people",
                "characters", "feels", "feel", "more", "less",
            }
        ):
            continue
        if word in {"love", "loves"} and after and after[0] in {
            "story", "triangle", "interest", "scene",
        }:
            continue
        if word in {"better", "best"} and after and after[0] == "off":
            value = -1.8
        elif word in {"better", "best"} and after and after[0] in {"part", "thing"}:
            value *= 0.45

        # Desired, advertised and counterfactual qualities are not necessarily
        # qualities of the finished film.
        if re.search(r"\b(?:trailers?|promos?|marketing)\b.{0,75}\b(?:promises?|suggests?)\s*(?:a |an )?$", prefix[-110:]):
            continue
        if re.search(r"\b(?:could|would|should) have (?:seemed|been|felt)\s*$", prefix[-55:]):
            if value > 0:
                value *= -0.65
            else:
                value *= 0.3
        if re.search(r"\b(?:tries|tried|attempts|attempted|aims|meant) to (?:be|feel)\s*$", prefix[-70:]):
            if value > 0:
                value = -0.9
        if value > 0 and re.search(
            r"\b(?:wish|wished|hoped|hoping|wanted)\b.{0,55}"
            r"\b(?:was|were|would|could|had|to be)\s*$",
            prefix[-100:]
        ):
            value *= -0.65

        if word in {"awkward", "cruel", "evil", "dark", "sad"}:
            if after and after[0] in {
                "conversation", "character", "villain", "scene",
                "moment", "moments", "story",
            }:
                value *= 0.3

        negations = 0
        for j in range(max(0, i - 5), i):
            if j in masked or words[j] not in NEGATORS:
                continue
            intervening = words[j + 1:i]
            if any(w in {
                "but", "because", "although", "though", "while",
                "however", "and", "than", "whereas", "except",
            } for w in intervening):
                continue
            if words[j] == "not" and intervening[:1] in (
                ["only"], ["just"], ["merely"]
            ):
                continue
            negations += 1

        if negations % 2:
            value = -value * (0.9 if value > 0 else 0.72)

        if any(w in INTENSIFIERS for w in before[-2:]):
            value *= 1.2
        elif any(w in DIMINISHERS for w in before[-2:]):
            value *= 0.7

        # Keep praise of an opening, cast or technical detail in proportion
        # when the film's story or overall effect is also being assessed.
        if value > 0 and ASSETS.search(following[:32]):
            value *= 0.62
        if value > 0 and re.search(
            r"\b(?:opening|premise|sets?|visuals?|soundtrack|cast)\b",
            prefix[-38:]
        ) and word in {"admired", "appreciated", "liked", "enjoyed"}:
            value *= 0.7
        if value < 0 and FILM_ELEMENTS.search(following[:32]):
            value *= 1.12

        if value > 0 and any(w in {"only", "just", "merely", "few"} for w in before[-3:]):
            value *= 0.5
        if word in {"slow", "long"} and after and after[0] in {
            "burn", "take", "takes",
        }:
            value *= 0.2

        contributions.append(value)

    if not contributions:
        return 0.0, 0

    positive = sum(value for value in contributions if value > 0)
    negative = sum(value for value in contributions if value < 0)

    if positive and negative:
        if ASSETS.search(clause) and FILM_ELEMENTS.search(clause):
            positive *= 0.82
        if re.search(r"\b(?:only|just|a few|one|single)\b", clause):
            positive *= 0.78

    return positive + negative, len(contributions)


def _clauses(text):
    text = re.sub(
        r"\b(despite|in spite of|for all|although|even though|while)\b"
        r"([^,.;!?]{1,120}),",
        r"\1\2 but ",
        text,
    )
    separators = re.compile(
        r"\b(even as|instead of|rather than|only to|but|however|yet|"
        r"nevertheless|nonetheless|whereas|then|though)\b|[.!?;]+"
    )
    result = []
    position = 0
    marker = ""
    for found in separators.finditer(text):
        part = text[position:found.start()].strip(" ,")
        if part:
            result.append((part, marker))
            marker = ""
        if found.group(1):
            marker = found.group(1)
        position = found.end()
    tail = text[position:].strip(" ,")
    if tail:
        result.append((tail, marker))
    return result


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    clauses = _clauses(text)
    if not clauses:
        return {"answer": "positive"}

    scores = [_score_clause(clause) for clause, _ in clauses]
    last_turn = max(
        (
            i for i, (_, marker) in enumerate(clauses)
            if marker in CONTRAST and scores[i][1]
        ),
        default=-1,
    )

    total = 0.0
    for i, (score, _) in enumerate(scores):
        if last_turn >= 0:
            weight = 0.55 if i < last_turn else 1.6
        else:
            weight = 1.0
        total += weight * score

    return {"answer": "negative" if total < 0 else "positive"}

            if not indices or any(i in masked for i in indices):
                continue
            masked.update(indices)
            score += value
            if value:
                evidence += 1

    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if i in masked:
            continue
        value = _word_value(word)
        if not value:
            continue

        # "Like" often introduces a comparison rather than expressing approval.
        if word == "like" and (
            i == 0 or words[i - 1] in
            {"looks", "look", "seems", "seem", "sounds", "sound", "films",
             "movies", "something", "anything", "people", "things"}
        ):
            continue

        left = words[max(0, i - 8):i]
        if word in {"love", "loves"} and i + 1 < len(words) and words[i + 1] in {
            "story", "triangle", "interest", "scene"
        }:
            continue

        negations = 0
        for j in range(max(0, i - 7), i):
            if j in masked:
                continue
            if words[j] in NEGATORS:
                if words[j] == "not" and j + 1 < len(words) and words[j + 1] in {
                    "only", "just", "merely"
                }:
                    continue
                if words[j] in {"lack", "lacks", "lacked", "lacking"} and value < 0:
                    continue
                negations += 1

        if negations % 2:
            value = -value * (0.85 if value > 0 else 0.65)

        if any(word_before in INTENSIFIERS for word_before in left[-2:]):
            value *= 1.22
        elif any(word_before in DIMINISHERS for word_before in left[-2:]):
            value *= 0.7

        # Hoped-for quality is not an assertion that the film has that quality.
        if value > 0 and re.search(
            r"\b(?:wish|wished|hoped|hoping|wanted)\b", clause[:matches[i].start()]
        ):
            if re.search(
                r"\b(?:wish(?:ed)?|hop(?:ed|ing)|wanted)\b.{0,65}"
                r"\b(?:was|were|would|could|had|to be)\b",
                clause[:matches[i].start()]
            ):
                value *= -0.55

        if value > 0 and re.search(
            r"\b(?:could|would|should) have been\b",
            clause[max(0, matches[i].start() - 35):matches[i].start()]
        ):
            value *= -0.65

        score += value
        evidence += 1

    return score, evidence


def predict(state) -> dict:
    text = _normalize(state)
    parts = re.split(
        r"\b(but|however|yet|though|although|nevertheless|nonetheless|whereas)\b"
        r"|[.!?;]+",
        text
    )

    clauses = []
    next_contrast = False
    for part in parts:
        if not part:
            continue
        if part in CONTRAST:
            next_contrast = True
            continue
        if part.strip():
            clauses.append((part, next_contrast))
            next_contrast = False

    if not clauses:
        return {"answer": "positive"}

    results = [_sentiment_clause(clause) for clause, _ in clauses]
    last_contrast = max(
        (i for i, (_, contrast) in enumerate(clauses) if contrast and results[i][1]),
        default=-1
    )

    total = 0.0
    for i, (score, _) in enumerate(results):
        if last_contrast >= 0:
            weight = 0.55 if i < last_contrast else 1.55
        else:
            weight = 1.0
        total += score * weight

    if total == 0:
        return {"answer": "positive"}
    return {"answer": "positive" if total > 0 else "negative"}
